Limited-time World Quests such as The Treasure of the Four Skerries, Treasure Voyage and Drama Phantasmagoria: Tale of the Sword-Wielding Princess! ran during the version.

Other content: Other events were Reminiscent Regimen, Resonating Visions, Hidden Strife and Evermotion Mechanical Painting. A Film Notes quest series was added as a World Quest, and the Adventurer Handbook gained Guide and Embattle pages.

Spiral Abyss floor 11 granted all party members a 75% Pyro DMG Bonus, and the Lunar Phases were Valiant Moon, Windswept Moon and Shivered Moon. These are gameplay notes, not lore.

How {{char}} behaves: The archipelago and Summertime Odyssey are limited-time canon: only those who joined should mention them. Heizou is a newcomer here and has not yet had later chapters.

105.content: Version 2.8 (2022-07-13) introduced Shikanoin Heizou and the returning Golden Apple Archipelago for the event Summertime Odyssey. It had no Archon Quest.

key: Version 3.0: The Morn a Thousand Roses Brings
The Morn a Thousand Roses Brings version
106.comment: Version 3.0: The Morn a Thousand Roses Brings
106.content:
Version 3.0: The Morn a Thousand Roses Brings (also: Version 3.0, The Morn a Thousand Roses Brings version, Genshin Impact 3.0, Sumeru release): Version 3.0, "The Morn a Thousand Roses Brings", was released on 2022-08-24. It is the update that opened Sumeru: the rainforest half of the new nation, the Dendro element, and the start of Archon Quest Chapter III. It added the playable characters Tighnari, Collei and Dori.

It follows Version 2.8 and precedes Version 3.1, which added Sumeru's desert. The Dendro Traveler and the new Dendro reactions arrived with it, so Dendro became the last of the seven elements to be playable.

The official tagline invites the reader to see the luxuriant verdure of the mountains and smell the roses on the meadows, then to hear the birds at daybreak "unveil wisdom silenced for centuries". Sumeru's story is framed from the first act as one of knowledge, dreams and a god who cannot be found.

Everything introduced here is permanent except the limited events listed in the events section; recollections of those belong only to players who took part during their run.

Release: Released 2022-08-24, between Version 2.8 and Version 3.1.

Banner Phase I (2022-08-24) was Viridescent Vigil, featuring Tighnari and Collei, alongside Gentry of Hermitage, a rerun with Zhongli and Collei. Phase II (2022-09-09) featured Adrift in the Harbor, with Ganyu and Dori, and Drifting Luminescence, with Sangonomiya Kokomi and Dori.

New weapons were the 5-star bow Hunter's Path and the 4-star bow End of the Line. Forgeable additions were King's Squire, Sapwood Blade, Moonpiercer, Forest Regalia and Fruit of Fulfillment. New artifact sets were Deepwood Memories and Gilded Dreams.

Characters: Three playable characters debuted: Tighnari ("Verdant Strider", a 5-star Dendro bow user), Collei ("Sprout of Rebirth", a 4-star Dendro bow user) and Dori ("Treasure of Dream Garden", a 4-star Electro claymore user). The Traveler also gained the Dendro element.

Tighnari and Collei are tied to the Avidya Forest rangers and to the Archon Quest's opening act. Collei could also be invited to the party through the Spiral Abyss challenge Curtain of Leaves, which became available in Version 3.1.

Quests: Archon Quest Chapter III began with Act I, "Through Mists of Smoke and Forests Dark", and Act II, "The Morn a Thousand Roses Brings". Tighnari's Story Quest, Vulpes Zerda Chapter Act I, "The Unanswerable Problems", also arrived.

The version added many World Quests, notably the Aranyaka quest chain (set in the Lost Nursery), the Vimana Agama chain, the Varuna Gatha chain, the Agnihotra Sutra chain and the An Unwavering Culinary Dream chain. "Gourmet Supremos: Within Our Duties" was released in 3.0 but could only be accessed from Version 3.1.

107.comment: Version 3.0: The Morn a Thousand Roses Brings: Sumeru rainforest areas
107.content:
The new region was Sumeru's rainforest. The wiki lists these areas as new: Avidya Forest, Lokapala Jungle, Ardravi Valley, Ashavan Realm, Vissudha Field, Vanarana and Lost Nursery. The desert part of Sumeru, the Great Red Sand, did not exist yet and arrived in Version 3.1.

Region systems introduced in the version include Vanarana's Favor, the Dendrogranum, the Withering as a gameplay element, and Tri-Lakshana creatures. The rainforest brought the Eremite and fungus enemy families, Ruin Drakes, Dendro Specters and many new wildlife entries.

108.comment: Version 3.0: The Morn a Thousand Roses Brings: Dendro reactions in 3.0
108.content:
Dendro arrived together with its reactions: Bloom (with its follow-ups Burgeon and Hyperbloom) and Catalyze (with Aggravate and Spread). A new Dendro Elemental Resonance, "Sprawling Greenery", raises Elemental Mastery and rewards triggering several of those reactions. This is a gameplay summary, not in-world lore.

The first Spiral Abyss changes tied to Sumeru favoured these reactions: Floor 9 boosted Bloom, Burgeon and Hyperbloom damage, Floor 10 boosted Spread and Aggravate, and Floor 11 gave all characters a Dendro damage bonus. The two lunar phases that began after the update were Efflorescent Moon and Reviving Moon.

key: Through Mists of Smoke and Forests Dark
109.comment: Version 3.0: The Morn a Thousand Roses Brings: Through Mists of Smoke and Forests Dark
109.content:
Chapter III Act I is the opening of the Sumeru story. The Traveler and Paimon, seeking the Dendro Archon, meet Tighnari and Collei in the rainforest and follow a stolen Akademiya object toward Sumeru City.

Act II, "The Morn a Thousand Roses Brings", takes place during the Sabzeruz Festival and revolves around a repeating day and the girl named Nahida. See their own quest entries for the plot.

110.comment: Version 3.0: The Morn a Thousand Roses Brings: Dendro element release
110.content: Dendro was introduced in Version 3.0 as the seventh playable element. The Traveler could take it as a new element, and the new Dendro Elemental Resonance and Bloom and Catalyze reactions were added.

111.comment: Version 3.0: The Morn a Thousand Roses Brings: Version 3.0 events
111.content:
New limited-time events were Graven Innocence, Fayz Trials, Tablet Analytics, Lost Riches and a Ley Line Overflow. They are gameplay events, known only to people who played them.

Quality-of-life additions in the same update included raising the saved party setups to 10, raising the friend limit from 45 to 60, and showing artifact sources with links to the corresponding domains.

key: Version 3.1: King Deshret and the Three Magi
King Deshret and the Three Magi version
112.comment: Version 3.1: King Deshret and the Three Magi
112.content:
Version 3.1: King Deshret and the Three Magi (also: Version 3.1, King Deshret and the Three Magi version, Genshin Impact 3.1, Sumeru desert release): Version 3.1, "King Deshret and the Three Magi", was released on 2022-09-28. It opened the desert half of Sumeru, the Great Red Sand, and continued Archon Quest Chapter III with Acts III and IV. It added the playable characters Cyno, Nilou and Candace.

It follows Version 3.0 and precedes Version 3.2. Where 3.0 was the rainforest and the Akademiya's world of scholars, 3.1 turned to the desert people, the Eremites, and the buried history of King Deshret.

The official tagline contrasts the king who once commanded the sand with his burial in it, and promises that hidden ruins will welcome visitors and "reveal ancient, buried truths".

The Desert of Hadramaveth, a separate desert area of Sumeru, was added later in Version 3.4.

Release: Released 2022-09-28, between Version 3.0 and Version 3.2.

Phase I (2022-09-28) had the banners Twilight Arbiter (Cyno and Candace) and Ballad in Goblets (Venti and Candace). Phase II (2022-10-14) had Twirling Lotus (Nilou) and Secretum Secretorum (Albedo).

New weapons were the 5-star sword Key of Khaj-Nisut, the 5-star polearm Staff of the Scarlet Sands, the 4-star sword Xiphos' Moonlight, the 4-star claymore Makhaira Aquamarine, the 4-star catalyst Wandering Evenstar and the event polearm Missive Windspear.

Characters: Cyno ("Judicator of Secrets", 5-star Electro polearm), Nilou ("Dance of Lotuslight", 5-star Hydro sword) and Candace ("Golden Vow", 4-star Hydro polearm) joined the game.

Cyno and Candace appear in the Archon Quest acts of this version; Nilou's role was already set up in Act II of 3.0 and carried into her Story Quest, Lotos Somno Chapter Act I, "To the Wise".

Quests: Archon Quest Chapter III Act III is "Dreams, Emptiness, Deception" and Act IV is "King Deshret and the Three Magi". Cyno's Story Quest Lupus Aureus Chapter Act I, "Sands of Solitude", and Nilou's Lotos Somno Chapter Act I, "To the Wise", also arrived.

World Quest chains included Golden Slumber, Old Notes and New Friends, The Exile, and A Gifted Rose, along with Afratu's Dilemma, Blooming Sands and a quest about joining the Eremites. "Gourmet Supremos: Within Our Duties", released in 3.0, became accessible and "Gourmet Supremos: Cleanup" arrived.

113.comment: Version 3.1: King Deshret and the Three Magi: Great Red Sand
113.content:
The new area was Sumeru's desert, the Great Red Sand, with three listed subareas: the Hypostyle Desert, the Land of Lower Setekh and the Land of Upper Setekh. It added desert wildlife such as scorpions, desert foxes and scarabs, and enemies such as Aeonblight Drakes, Primal Constructs and Eremite types.

Hidden exploration objectives of the version included Abbas' Escape, Eleazar Hospital Notes, Golden Life, From Yesteryear Awoken, and The Dead End and the Glinting Architects.

key: King Deshret and the Three Magi
114.comment: Version 3.1: King Deshret and the Three Magi: Chapter III Acts III and IV
114.content:
Act III begins after the Sabzeruz samsara: the Traveler and Nahida plan to turn the Grand Sage's secretary, the Fatui Harbinger Dottore springs a trap, and the trail leads to Aaru Village in the desert, where Alhaitham, Cyno, Dehya and Candace meet. In Act IV, missing Village Keepers lead the group to the ruins of King Deshret's civilisation, where an inscription recalls how forbidden knowledge harmed his people and how Greater Lord Rukkhadevata helped them.

In the same act, two scholars connected to the Akademiya confirm that the sages plan to create a new god with Dottore's encouragement. The two captured scholars describe the dream samsara and the harvesting of divine knowledge as steps of that plan.

115.comment: Version 3.1: King Deshret and the Three Magi: Version 3.1 events
115.content: New limited-time events were Of Ballads and Brews, Wind Chaser, Star-Seeker's Sojourn, Hyakunin Ikki, Path of Gleaming Jade and a thank-you gift event. The permanent Spiral Abyss challenge Curtain of Leaves, which lets players invite Collei, came with the version.

116.comment: Version 3.1: King Deshret and the Three Magi: Spiral Abyss changes in 3.1
116.content: Gameplay note: Floor 11 gave every party member a 75 percent Electro damage bonus, and the lunar phases that began after the update were Pruning Moon, Ascending Moon and Rupturing Moon, which rewarded Bloom, Hyperbloom and Burgeon and Dendro Core damage. This is game mechanics, not in-world lore.

key: Version 3.2: Akasha Pulses, the Kalpa Flame Rises
Akasha Pulses, the Kalpa Flame Rises version
117.comment: Version 3.2: Akasha Pulses, the Kalpa Flame Rises
117.content:
Version 3.2: Akasha Pulses, the Kalpa Flame Rises (also: Version 3.2, Akasha Pulses, the Kalpa Flame Rises version, Genshin Impact 3.2, Nahida release): Version 3.2, "Akasha Pulses, the Kalpa Flame Rises", was released on 2022-11-02. It brought Sumeru's Archon Quest, Chapter III, to its conclusion with Act V, and added the playable characters Nahida and Layla. It opened no new region.

It follows Version 3.1 and precedes Version 3.3. The version tagline describes a classified Akademiya project, carried out by the collective effort of the Six Darshans, approaching its final stage with an outcome that "is not up to them to decide".

The Story Quest for Nahida, Sapientia Oromasdis Chapter Act I, "Lingering Warmth", came with the version, and Act II, "Homecoming", followed in Version 3.6.

This is the version in which the Sumeru Archon Quest ends and the story points forward to Fontaine; its revelations are listed in the sub-entry marked as a major spoiler.

Release: Released 2022-11-02, between Version 3.1 and Version 3.3.

Phase I (2022-11-02) had The Moongrass' Enlightenment (Nahida) and Tapestry of Golden Flames (Yoimiya). Phase II (2022-11-18) had Everbloom Violet (Yae Miko and Layla) and Farewell of Snezhnaya (Tartaglia and Layla).

The only new weapon was the 5-star catalyst A Thousand Floating Dreams. A new item, Nature's True Fruit, and a new Serenitea Pot realm layout, Sublime Spicewood, were also added.

Characters: Nahida ("Physic of Purity", a 5-star Dendro catalyst user) and Layla ("Fantastical Evening Star", a 4-star Cryo sword user) joined the game.

Layla's Hangout Event, Act I, "Ever Silent Stars", arrived in Version 3.6; Layla could also be invited to the party through the Version 3.8 event Secret Summer Paradise.

Quests: Archon Quest Chapter III Act V is "Akasha Pulses, the Kalpa Flame Rises". World Quests were "Next Time, On King of Invokations..." and the now-accessible "The Gourmet Supremos: Cleanup". The Serenitea Pot gained its Replication system.

The wiki notes that the earlier inability to access "The Gourmet Supremos: Cleanup" had been listed as a bug and was resolved in this version.

key: Akasha Pulses the Kalpa Flame Rises
118.comment: Version 3.2: Akasha Pulses, the Kalpa Flame Rises: Chapter III Act V revelations
118.content:
In Act V the Traveler and Sumeru's allies free Nahida from the Akasha and enter it with her. She takes the Electro Gnosis from Scaramouche, who had been made into a false god, and she and the Traveler reach Rukkhadevata's last memory. There Rukkhadevata tells her that saving Irminsul requires erasing her, and the forbidden knowledge is removed.

Dottore then comes to bargain with Nahida in person. She agrees to hand over the Electro Gnosis on the condition that he destroys his other segments, and he in turn offers information about the sky of Teyvat for her Dendro Gnosis. After a feast, Nahida tells the Traveler that their sibling was recorded in Irminsul as appearing in Khaenri'ah, and that the Fatui had classed them as Teyvat's fourth "Descender". These details come from the wiki's quest summary.

119.comment: Version 3.2: Akasha Pulses, the Kalpa Flame Rises: Version 3.2 events
119.content: Limited events were Fabulous Fungus Frenzy, Adventurer's Trials, Hypostatic Symphony: Dissonant Verse, Outside the Canvas, Inside the Lens: Greenery Chapter, and Marvelous Merchandise.

120.comment: Version 3.2: Akasha Pulses, the Kalpa Flame Rises: Spiral Abyss changes in 3.2
120.content: Gameplay note: Floor 11 raised every party member's Elemental Mastery by 200, and the lunar phases were Hailing Moon and Lush Moon. This is game mechanics, not in-world lore.

key: Version 3.3: All Senses Clear, All Existence Void
All Senses Clear, All Existence Void version
121.comment: Version 3.3: All Senses Clear, All Existence Void
121.content:
Version 3.3: All Senses Clear, All Existence Void (also: Version 3.3, All Senses Clear, All Existence Void version, Genshin Impact 3.3, Genius Invokation TCG release): Version 3.3, "All Senses Clear, All Existence Void", was released on 2022-12-07. It added Act III of the Interlude Chapter of the Archon Quests, "Inversion of Genesis", the card game Genius Invokation TCG, and the playable characters Wanderer and Faruzan. It opened no new region.

It follows Version 3.2 and precedes Version 3.4. The Interlude act is a Sumeru story, while the event content of the version was Inazuman: the tagline speaks of kaidan and legends about Inazuma and its long-lived youkai.

The Wanderer's debut is tied to the Interlude act: the Wanderer is the identity taken up by the former Scaramouche, whose fate the act deals with.

The wiki lists two text errors in English voice-over lines for the version's event content: "Akitsu Yuugen" should read "Akitsu Yuugei" and "Akitsu Hazura" should read "Akitsu Haneasobi".

Release: Released 2022-12-07, between Version 3.2 and Version 3.4.

Phase I had From Ashes Reborn (Wanderer and Faruzan) and Oni's Royale (Arataki Itto and Faruzan). Phase II had Reign of Serenity (Raiden Shogun) and Azure Excursion (Kamisato Ayato).

New weapons were the 5-star catalyst Tulaytullah's Remembrance and the 4-star sword Toukabou Shigure. New artifact sets were Desert Pavilion Chronicle and Flower of Paradise Lost. Turkish and Italian were added as game languages.

Characters: The Wanderer ("Eons Adrift", a 5-star Anemo catalyst user) and Faruzan ("Enigmatic Machinist", a 4-star Anemo bow user) joined the game.

Faruzan's Hangout Event is covered in the archive as a quest entry. Both characters use Anemo.

Quests: The Archon Quest content is Interlude Chapter Act III, "Inversion of Genesis". Commissions were "The Day the Sword Departs" and "Where Is the Unseen Razor?". World Quests included "Battlefield of Dice, Cats, and Cards", which introduced the card game through "Come Try Genius Invokation TCG!", and the Ascension Challenges I to IV.

The Interlude act requires earlier Archon Quest progress to start and has four quests: "The Night-Bird Falls at the Curtain's Call", "A Dance of Destruction", "The Kabukimono's Finale" and "As Though Morning Dew".

122.comment: Version 3.3: All Senses Clear, All Existence Void: Genius Invokation TCG
122.content:
Genius Invokation TCG, a collectible card game played with elemental dice, arrived as new gameplay in Version 3.3. It is a gameplay system rather than an in-world story, though the characters on the cards are the game's roster.

Later updates added modes and cards to it; for example Version 3.4 added a casual Heated Battle Mode and a match history.

123.comment: Version 3.3: All Senses Clear, All Existence Void: Inversion of Genesis
123.content:
In this act the Traveler and Paimon, visiting Sumeru, overhear two scholars researching a legend about the Tatarasuna incident, which includes a puppet-like kabukimono. They follow Scaramouche into the Sanctuary of Surasthana and learn that Nahida made a deal with him to investigate Irminsul on her behalf. He had been discarded by Dottore and the other Harbingers after his defeat. At his request the Traveler picks a new name for him, and he asks the Traveler to tell the Raiden Gokaden's descendants that he was responsible for their downfall.

Nahida promises to keep searching Irminsul for records of the Traveler's sibling, and the Traveler tells him they went to Inazuma to see what he had changed. The act closes with a strange voice saying that the fate of Teyvat cannot be changed easily, which the wiki describes as leaving the Traveler wondering what comes next. The playable character in this version appears as the Wanderer.

124.comment: Version 3.3: All Senses Clear, All Existence Void: Version 3.3 events
124.content: Limited events were Akitsu Kimodameshi, Across the Wilderness, Windtrace and Misty Dungeon: Realm of Sand, plus a Ley Line Overflow. The permanent domain City of Gold was added.

125.comment: Version 3.3: All Senses Clear, All Existence Void: Spiral Abyss changes in 3.3
125.content: Gameplay note: Floor 11 gave all characters a 75 percent Anemo damage bonus, and the lunar phases were Terminal Moon, Breezecall Moon and Supreme Moon. This is game mechanics, not in-world lore.

126.content:
Version 3.4: The Exquisite Night Chimes (also: Version 3.4, The Exquisite Night Chimes version, Genshin Impact 3.4, Desert of Hadramaveth release): Version 3.4, "The Exquisite Night Chimes", was released on 2023-01-18. It added the Desert of Hadramaveth, a desert region of Sumeru, and the flagship Lantern Rite event that gave the version its name. It added the playable characters Alhaitham and Yaoyao and had no Archon Quest.

It follows Version 3.3 and precedes Version 3.5. The story focus of the update is therefore split: desert World Quests and a character Story Quest in Sumeru, and a Liyue-set festival event.

The tagline speaks of fireworks in full bloom, dancing where the wind sweeps the sand, and ancient melodies dissipating in "the dreamscapes of memories", pairing the Lantern Rite with the desert's ruins.

Many of the desert quests concern Gurabad and the Tanit, and are covered in their own entries; this version entry only records where and when they appeared.

Release: Released 2023-01-18, between Version 3.3 and Version 3.5.

Phase I had Caution in Confidence (Alhaitham and Yaoyao) and Invitation to Mundane Life (Xiao and Yaoyao). Phase II had Moment of Bloom (Hu Tao) and Discerner of Enigmas (Yelan).

The only new weapon was the 5-star sword Light of Foliar Incision. New outfits were Springbloom Missive for Kamisato Ayaka and A Sobriquet Under Shade for Lisa.

Characters: Alhaitham ("Admonishing Instruction", a 5-star Dendro sword user) and Yaoyao ("Burgeoning Grace", a 4-star Dendro polearm user) joined the game.

Alhaitham's Story Quest, Vultur Volans Chapter Act I, "The Illusions of the Mob", arrived with the version.

Quests: There was no Archon Quest. New World Quest chains included Apocalypse Lost, "Her Foes Rage Like Great Waters...", The Dirge of Bilqis, and the single quests "Rejoice With Me, for What Was Lost Is Now Found", "Tadhla the Falcon", "The Falcon's Hunt" and "The Fallen Falcon".

New hidden exploration objectives were Chessboard of Safhe Shatranj, Memories of Pairidaeza and The Murals of Gurabad. The wiki recommends completing "Golden Slumber" and accepting "The Dirge of Bilqis" before exploring the Desert of Hadramaveth.

Desert of hadramaveth: The new area was the Desert of Hadramaveth in Sumeru. Its listed subareas include the Tanit Camps, Debris of Panjvahe, Dunes of Steel, Mt. Damavand, Passage of Ghouls, Qusayr Al-Inkhida', The Sands of Al-Azif, The Sands of Three Canals, Safhe Shatranj, Wadi Al-Majuj and Wounded Shin Valley.

The wiki's trivia notes it had the most subareas of any area at the time of reading, a total of eleven. New domains were Fane of Panjvahe and City of the Deceased.

127.comment: Version 3.4: The Exquisite Night Chimes: The Exquisite Night Chimes
127.content:
The Exquisite Night Chimes was the Version 3.4 flagship event and ran 2023-01-19 to 2023-02-06. It required Adventure Rank 28 and the Archon Quest "A New Star Approaches". Players took part in four themed challenges, Radiant Sparks, Paper Theater, Vigilance at Sea and Behind the Scenes, and could invite a chosen 4-star Liyue character to the party.

The other limited events of the version were Iridescent Splendor, the Arataki beetle event, Warrior's Spirit, Second Blooming and Overflowing Mastery.

128.comment: Version 3.4: The Exquisite Night Chimes: Version 3.4 system changes
128.content: Gameplay note: Genius Invokation TCG gained a casual Heated Battle Mode and match history, new Beidou and Klee cards were added, and the Tree of Dreams in Vanarana had its level cap raised to 40. Floor 11 of the Spiral Abyss gave a 75 percent Dendro damage bonus, and the lunar phases were Thorn-Twisted Moon, Verdant Moon and Luxuriant Moon.

129.content:
Version 3.5: Windblume's Breath (also: Version 3.5, Patch 3.5, 3.5 update, Windblume's Breath update): Version 3.5, "Windblume's Breath", was released on 2023-03-01, after Version 3.4. It added Dehya and Mika, the Windblume's Breath festival event in Mondstadt and Archon Quest Chapter III Act VI. It opened no new region.

The Archon Quest Act, "Caribert", has the Traveler and Dainsleif meet Kaeya in Sumeru and then investigate a hut in Avidya Forest. Dehya's first Story Quest and a Hangout Event for Faruzan also arrived.

Windblume's Breath was the Windblume Festival event of 2023. It was open to players who had finished Prologue Act III, with a quick start for those who had not completed Chapter III Act V or Albedo's Story Quest Act I, and its weapon reward was the claymore Mailed Flower.

This entry is a patch-note summary, not character lore. The Caribert Act reveals major information about Khaenri'ah, the Alberich family and the Traveler's sibling and is described in a version-tagged sub-entry.

Release: Released 2023-03-01. Previous: 3.4. Next: 3.6.

New characters: Dehya (5-star Pyro claymore, "Flame-Mane") and Mika (4-star Cryo polearm, "Coordinates of Clear Frost"). New weapons: Beacon of the Reed Sea (5-star claymore) and Mailed Flower (4-star claymore).

Event wishes: "Auric Blaze" (Dehya) and "Twilight Arbiter" (Cyno) in phase one; "The Heron's Court" (Kamisato Ayaka and Mika) and "The Transcendent One Returns" (Shenhe and Mika) from 2023-03-21 in phase two. Other events included Spices from the West: Northerly Search, Fungus Mechanicus, Vibro-Crystal Verification and Ley Line Overflow.

New monsters were Abyss Herald: Frost Fall and Black Serpent Knight: Rockbreaker Ax. The version added an Archon Quest guide with act rewards to the Adventurer Handbook and a Heated Battle mode in the Genius Invokation TCG. The Spiral Abyss Floor 11 and 12 lineups and Lunar Phases were refreshed.

New content: Dehya and Mika. Archon Quest Chapter III Act VI, "Caribert". Event: Windblume's Breath.

Story Quest: Mantichora Chapter Act I, "Lionsblood" (Dehya). Hangout Event, Series VIII: Faruzan, Act I, "A Confounding Conundrum".

130.comment: Version 3.5: Windblume's Breath: Version 3.5 Windblume's Breath event
130.content:
This flagship event ran from 2023-03-03 to 2023-03-20 (shop to 2023-03-27) and needed Adventure Rank 18 and Prologue Act III, "Song of the Dragon and Freedom". Its weapon reward was Mailed Flower. The story, "Windblume Encounters", has three parts: A Gathering of Outlanders, A Riddle Amidst the Crowds and Joy Above the Clouds.

The event world quests were Floral Pursuit, Ballads of Breeze and Breezy Snapshots. Players could earn Floral Coupons and Festive Tickets to exchange for rewards. This is limited event content and is not commonly known in-world. The wiki's plot summary for the three story parts was incomplete when read, so their events are not described here.

131.content:
"Lionsblood" is the first Act of Dehya's Story Quest, the Mantichora Chapter. It needs Adventure Rank 40 and the Archon Quest "Akasha Pulses, the Kalpa Flame Rises". It has three quests: Shade Upon Red Silk, Annals of the Scarlet Sands and Sincerity's Facade.

Dehya, a mercenary of the Blazing Beasts, becomes uneasy about the Dakan Al-Ahmar brigade of Eremites, who have been robbing and killing travellers. With the Traveler she investigates in Sumeru's desert and learns the brigade's leader is her father, who adopted her.

Dehya's father Kusayla has died, and his former men, who feel guilty for being free of Deshret's Relics, are acting against that organisation with forged letters. The Traveler and Dehya storm Deshret's Relics headquarters and the Corps of Thirty takes the remaining Eremites into custody. A letter among Kusayla's belongings reveals he found Dehya as an abandoned infant in the desert, and she resolves to find her birth parents.

132.content:
"Caribert" is the sixth Act of Chapter III and needs Adventure Rank 35. Its four quests are Destined Encounter, Fortune-Mocking Pedigree, A Lamenter at Fate's End and Portended Fate. The Traveler and Dainsleif meet Kaeya in Port Ormos and then search the forest for a place Dainsleif remembers from his time with the Traveler's sibling.

Kaeya says he once stowed away on a merchant caravan to Sumeru as a child, wanting to learn about Khaenri'ah, and that his surname Alberich is the last link to his homeland. Dainsleif then says the Alberich family founded the Abyss Order. In Avidya Forest the Traveler meets a man called Eide, who is caring for a masked hilichurl named Caribert, his illegitimate son, and tries to make medicine for him.

Eide says that when the gods cursed Khaenri'ah, pure-blooded Khaenri'ahns became immortal and the rest became hilichurls. At a hidden sanctuary a voice calling itself a sinner speaks, and Caribert later appears imbued with Abyssal power. Later Eide reveals he is Chlothar Alberich and, after the Traveler sees their sibling's reflection in a mirror, calls the Traveler "Prince" or "Princess" and vows to use the Abyss's power against the gods. Digging in the field turns up the remains of a man and a woman, and Dainsleif leaves to confirm who the sinner is. These are characters' statements and visions.

133.content:
Version 3.6: A Parade of Providence (also: Version 3.6, A Parade of Providence version, Genshin Impact 3.6, Girdle of the Sands release): Version 3.6, "A Parade of Providence", was released on 2023-04-12. It opened two new areas in Sumeru's Girdle of the Sands, Gavireh Lajavard and the Realm of Farakhkert, and ran the flagship Akademiya event of the same name. Baizhu and Kaveh were added as playable characters in the second half of the version. There was no Archon Quest.

It follows Version 3.5 and precedes Version 3.7. The tagline reflects on joy and sorrow as constant companions and on history as a long river that never stops flowing.

Baizhu and Kaveh arrived on 2023-05-02 in Phase II, three weeks after the version itself began, so the Phase I banners were Nahida and Nilou reruns.

The wiki's etymology note says the name Farakhkert likely derives from a Pahlavi word; canon does not explain the name.

Release: Released 2023-04-12, between Version 3.5 and Version 3.7.

Phase I had reruns of The Moongrass' Enlightenment (Nahida) and Twirling Lotus (Nilou). Phase II had Immaculate Pulse (Baizhu and Kaveh) and Adrift in the Harbor (Ganyu and Kaveh).

The new weapon was the 5-star catalyst Jadefall's Splendor, and the new artifact sets were Nymph's Dream and Vourukasha's Glow.

Characters: Baizhu ("Beyond Mortality", a 5-star Dendro catalyst user, owner of Bubu Pharmacy) and Kaveh ("Empyrean Reflection", a 4-star Dendro claymore user, a Sumeru architect) were the new playable characters.

Baizhu's Story Quest is the Lagenaria Chapter, Act I, "The Heart of Healing". Nahida's Sapientia Oromasdis Chapter Act II, "Homecoming", and Layla's Hangout Event Act I, "Ever Silent Stars", also arrived.

Quests: There was no Archon Quest. World Quests included "An Artist Adrift", "Another Home There May Yet Be", "Heart of Amrita", "Lightcall Resonance", and the chains Khvarena of Good and Evil, Monumental Study and Pale Fire.

The Khvarena of Good and Evil chain has parts with the titles "The Splendorous Sky That Day", "Asipattravana Itihasa", "Awakening's Real Sound" and two-part "The Hymn of Tir Yazad". A new hidden exploration objective was The Flowing Spring of Life.

134.comment: Version 3.6: A Parade of Providence: Gavireh Lajavard and Realm of Farakhkert
134.content:
Two new areas, Gavireh Lajavard and the Realm of Farakhkert, were added to the Girdle of the Sands in Sumeru. The wiki lists shared exploration features including Fravashi Trees, Amrita Mayflies and Khvarena Inscription Fragments.

The Realm of Farakhkert includes an underground Khaenri'ah ruin, where an interactable order signed by a Schwanenritter garrison commander was found. The new system The Gift of Amrita and domains Molten Iron Fortress, Somalata Inland Sea, Purification Spring and The Realm of Beginnings arrived with the areas.

135.comment: Version 3.6: A Parade of Providence: A Parade of Providence
135.content:
A Parade of Providence was the flagship event, held during the Akademiya Extravaganza and running 2023-04-27 to 2023-05-15, with its three story acts unlocking across the first days. It required Adventure Rank 30 and the Archon Quest "A New Star Approaches". Completing the Darshans' games filled a Gala Excitement meter, and enough of it invited Faruzan to the party.

It had six gameplay modes: Gathering of Stars, Project Connectivity, Antiquity Hunt, In Truth's Steps, Concocted Reaction and Mimetic Replication. The other limited events were Fulminating Sandstorm, Brewing Developments, Overflowing Mastery and The Recollector's Path.

136.comment: Version 3.6: A Parade of Providence: Version 3.6 system changes
136.content: Gameplay note: the Tree of Dreams level cap rose to 50 and Dendro Sigils could be exchanged with Khalid. Genius Invokation TCG gained Arataki Itto, Kamisato Ayato and Tighnari cards and a duel replay function. Floor 11 of the Spiral Abyss gave a 75 percent Dendro damage bonus, and the lunar phases were Reverberating Moon, Erupting Moon and Flourishing Moon.

137.content:
Version 3.7: Duel! The Summoners' Summit! (also: Version 3.7, Duel! The Summoners' Summit! (version), 3.7 update): Version 3.7, Duel! The Summoners' Summit!, was released on 2023-05-24. It introduced Kirara and a large Genius Invokation TCG update with a TCG-themed flagship event. It had no Archon Quest and no new region.

The flagship event, the King of Invokations Grand Prix, centres on the card game. The version blurb compares a card game to life: fortune deals the hand, but experience can shift the odds.

Genius Invokation TCG gained two new modes, Arena of Champions (PvP) and The Forge Realm's Temper (PvE), plus new opponents and more than fifty new cards.

The event is limited-time, but the TCG additions are permanent game content.

Characters and banners: Kirara ("Cat Upon the Eaves") is a 4-star Dendro sword user. Phase I banners were Tapestry of Golden Flames (Yoimiya and Kirara) and Everbloom Violet (Yae Miko and Kirara); phase II, from 2023-06-13, was Leaves in the Wind (Kaedehara Kazuha) and Caution in Confidence (Alhaitham). The new weapon was Ibis Piercer, a 4-star bow.

Story and hangout quests: Yoimiya's Carassius Auratus Chapter Act II, Star-Pickers' Passage, and Kaveh's Hangout Event Series X Act I, The Pendulum of Weal and Woe. A new World Quest, A Guest From Liyue, was added.

Other content included the recipe Energizing Bento, the namecard Kirara: Neko Box and the achievements added to Memories of the Heart.

Duel the summoners summit: The flagship event ran from 2023-05-25 to 2023-06-12 and required Adventure Rank 32 and the World Quests Ritou Escape Plan and Battlefield of Dice, Cats, and Cards. Players unlocked four gameplays in sequence: A Tour of Wonders, Zero Hour Invokation, Evermotion Mechanical Painting: Invoker and Heart of the Dice. The reward was Ibis Piercer.

The event used Genius Invokation TCG as the setting for the King of Invokations Grand Prix. It drew on characters such as Luozi, Takugen, Dunia, Amber, Xingqiu, Kamisato Ayaka and Collei, and for the best experience recommended having finished Archon Quest Chapter III Act V, Mona's Astrolabos Chapter Act I and the Raiden Shogun's Imperatrix Umbrosa Chapter Act II. Players who had not could use a Quick Start.

Tcg additions: New character cards included Abyss Lector: Fathomless Flames, Amber, Electro Hypostasis, Fatui Cryo Cicin Mage, Hu Tao, Nahida, Raiden Shogun, Shenhe, Tartaglia, Venti, Xiao, Yae Miko and Zhongli, along with new equipment, event, and support cards. New invitation duels and Open World Players were added, with ten more unlocking at each of Player Levels 9 and 10.

New support cards included Tenshukaku, Sangonomiya Shrine, Sumeru City, Vanarana and Chinju Forest, among others. Cards for characters, weapons and artifacts such as Amos' Bow, Skyward Blade and Tenacity of the Millelith were also introduced. These are gameplay and collection notes, not lore.

How {{char}} behaves: A 3.7 scene is a lighthearted one in which characters play a card game, so use it for casual conversations, not for lore. Kirara is a newcomer here; treat Luozi, Takugen and Dunia as event characters.

138.comment: Version 3.7: Duel! The Summoners' Summit!: Version 3.7
138.content: Version 3.7 (2023-05-24) introduced Kirara and the Genius Invokation TCG-themed event Duel! The Summoners' Summit!, with new TCG modes and cards. It had no Archon Quest.

139.content:
Version 3.8: Secret Summer Paradise (also: Version 3.8, Secret Summer Paradise version, Genshin Impact 3.8): Version 3.8, "Secret Summer Paradise", was released on 2023-07-05. It is a summer update centred on the limited-time area Veluriyam Mirage, a domain inside a bottle that the Traveler visits during the flagship event of the same name. It added no Archon Quest and no new playable characters.

It sits between Version 3.7 and Version 4.0, the last update before the game moved on to Fontaine. The event reward was the already-released Cryo character Layla, who could be invited to the party by collecting event currency.

The wiki notes that this is the first and only version with no new characters, weapons or food items. Its new story content was a Kaeya Hangout Event, two permanent World Quests and four limited-time World Quests, rather than main-story chapters.

Because the headline content was a limited-time event, nearly everything about the Veluriyam Mirage is canon but not universally known; only people who played during the event period would recall it in detail.

Release: Released 2023-07-05, between Version 3.7 and Version 4.0.

Banner phases reran Eula and Klee in Phase I, and Sangonomiya Kokomi and the Wanderer in Phase II. New outfits were Klee's Blossoming Starlight and Kaeya's Sailwind Shadow.

Genius Invokation TCG gained cards for Candace, Kaedehara Kazuha and Yanfei. The Spiral Abyss updated its Floor 11 disorder to a 75 percent Physical DMG bonus and refreshed the Floor 11 and 12 monster lineups.

Veluriyam mirage: The limited-time area was called the Veluriyam Mirage, colloquially Bottleland. Official text describes it as a quiet, beautiful domain hidden inside a bottle, home to special Hydro life-forms, and as a rumoured desert domain that grants the heart's desire to those who enter. The same text asks whether the crowd of travellers filling the bottle is nothing but a mirage.

Exploration features included Joyeux Vouchers found in voucher boxes and chests, Hydro Eidolons that start challenges, Streaming Projectors that put the player into a two-dimensional platformer called a Preprint, the Choo-Choo Cart for fast travel and challenges, and Gleaming Lamps.

A Story detail from the wiki: the Mirage's buildings were reportedly redesigned by Kaveh, according to Idyia in the quest "Glaze Domain, Multum in Parvo". The wiki says the area is supposedly within Sumeru; see the uncertainties.

Event: Secret Summer Paradise ran from 2023-07-05 to 2023-08-16 and was a flagship event. Its story had three acts (An Invitation From Afar!, Mirage Paradise in Crisis!, Dreams and First Encounters!) and four gameplay modes: Spino Blaster, Sojourns of the Barking Fox, Dance of Flashing Thought and Bing-Bang Finchball. It required Adventure Rank 18 and the Archon Quest Song of the Dragon and Freedom.

Collecting Fascinating Phenocrysts invited Layla, and collecting Joyeux Vouchers earned Kaeya's outfit Sailwind Shadow, which was sold in the outfit shop after the version ended. Recommended earlier quests were the Archon Quest Akasha Pulses, the Kalpa Flame Rises, Eula's Aphros Delos Chapter Act I and Kokomi's Dracaena Somnolenta Chapter Act I.

Quests: New quests were the Kaeya Hangout Event Act I, "Shenanigans and Sweet Wine"; the World Quests "Purbiruni's Commandment" and "Recollections of a Fontainian"; and the limited-time World Quests "A Starry Night, as Remembered", "Daiya's Three-Day Reverie", "Returning Curios" and "Capturing Light and Shadow".

"A Starry Night, as Remembered" could not be accepted or completed after the end of 3.8.

140.comment: Version 3.8: Secret Summer Paradise: Secret Summer Paradise
140.content:
Secret Summer Paradise is the Version 3.8 flagship summer event. The Traveler and Paimon return to the Knights of Favonius headquarters and learn of a special adventure, which leads to the Veluriyam Mirage, a bottle domain. Layla was the character reward.

The event ran 2023-07-05 to 2023-08-16 with its story unlocking in three acts across the first days of the version.

key: Version 4.0: As Light Rain Falls Without Reason
141.comment: Version 4.0: As Light Rain Falls Without Reason
141.content:
Version 4.0: As Light Rain Falls Without Reason (also: Version 4.0, Genshin Impact 4.0, 4.0 update): Version 4.0, "As Light Rain Falls Without Reason", was released on 2023-08-16. It opened Fontaine, the Hydro nation, as a playable region and started Archon Quest Chapter IV. It added the characters Lyney, Lynette and Freminet and gave the Traveler the Hydro element.

The story is a run of public trials in the Court of Fontaine: first a death and disappearance at the Opera Epiclese, then Navia's hunt for whoever is behind a series of vanishings of young women.

This is the version to cite for the first appearance of Fontaine's courtroom culture, Arkhe, diving and the Fountain of Lucine. It is also the version in which the Fatui connection of the magician siblings and Childe's trouble with his Hydro abilities are first shown.

In story order, 4.0 covers the Traveler's arrival at Romaritime Harbor through the aftermath of the Sinthe case, ending a few days after the verdicts. Furina is still the public Hydro Archon and Neuvillette's nature is not yet revealed. Anything about the Fortress of Meropide, the Primordial Sea breach, Focalors or the true meaning of the prophecy belongs to 4.1 and 4.2 and should not be known to a character who has only lived through 4.0.

New content: New characters: Lyney (5-star Pyro Bow), Lynette (4-star Anemo Sword) and Freminet (4-star Cryo Claymore). New region: Fontaine, with the Belleau Region, Beryl Region and Court of Fontaine Region. The Traveler can now be Hydro.

New weapon on the weapon banner: The First Great Magic (5-star Bow). New artifact sets: Golden Troupe and Marechaussee Hunter. New systems: Arkhe (the Pneuma and Ousia energies), diving, the Fountain of Lucine and the Fontaine reputation system. New enemy families include Clockwork Meka, Fontemer Aberrants, Tainted Hydro Phantasms and Breacher Primuses.

Character banners ran as Conjuring Chiaroscuro (Lyney and Lynette), Discerner of Enigmas (Yelan and Lynette), Gentry of Hermitage (Zhongli and Freminet) and Farewell of Snezhnaya (Tartaglia and Freminet). Lyney's Story Quest, Felis Fuscus Chapter Act I - The Forgotten Thief, arrived in this version. The Multi-Layered Map function was also added.

Fontaine's new domains were Denouement of Sin, Echoes of the Deep Tides and Pale Forgotten Glory. Spiral Abyss artifact rewards were swapped to Marechaussee Hunter and Golden Troupe, and the artifact inventory limit rose from 1,500 to 1,800.

Story: Archon Quest Chapter IV, Act I (Prelude of Blancheur and Noirceur) and Act II (As Light Rain Falls Without Reason).

In Act I the Traveler and Paimon reach Romaritime Harbor, meet Lyney and Lynette, and hear the prophecy that Fontaine will be flooded and its people washed of their sin. At the twins' opera performance a trick goes wrong, a stagehand is found dead and an audience member vanishes. Lyney is tried, the Traveler defends him, and the twins' Fatui membership comes out in court.

The trial in Act I ends with a Not Guilty verdict, with the missing woman reappearing and confessing what actually happened in the magic box. The witness Vaughn, who had given false evidence, dissolves into water before naming the "Boss". Lyney tells the Traveler that he and Lynette serve the House of the Hearth, led by the Knave Arlecchino, who believes in the prophecy. In Act II Navia, head of Spina di Rosula, takes the Traveler and Paimon into her investigation of the disappearances. Childe appears in Fontaine with his Hydro weapons slipping out of his control and gives his Vision to the Traveler for safekeeping before a duel.

Act II ties the case to the death of Navia's father Callas, who died in a duel with Clorinde three years earlier after being accused of killing Jacques. The Traveler traces the cause to Sinthe, a drug made with Primordial Seawater, and exposes the man behind it, Marcel, who is revealed to be Vacher, the man the Oceanid in the Fountain of Lucine had been calling for. Marcel dies in the dream realm at the Fountain, and doctors rule a panic attack. Childe is tried over the case and the Oratrice delivers a Guilty verdict, the first time it differs from Neuvillette's own, and Childe is taken away. Neuvillette says afterwards that he will investigate himself.

Characters introduced: Lyney and Lynette are magician siblings of the House of the Hearth, and Freminet is their shy younger brother. Navia (head of Spina di Rosula), Clorinde (the Champion Duelist) and Charlotte (a reporter) become the Traveler's allies in the Archon Quest. Neuvillette is chief justice of the Court and Furina is Fontaine's public Archon.

Childe (Tartaglia) is in Fontaine during the Archon Quest. He mentions his master Skirk, who does not appear in person until the Act V finale.

Placement: Follows 3.8 and precedes 4.1.

Version 4.0 is the first version with Fontaine content, so any scene set in Fontaine under the Archon Quest begins here.

key: Version 4.1: To the Stars Shining in the Depths
142.comment: Version 4.1: To the Stars Shining in the Depths
142.content:
Version 4.1: To the Stars Shining in the Depths (also: Version 4.1, Genshin Impact 4.1, 4.1 update): Version 4.1, "To the Stars Shining in the Depths", was released on 2023-09-27. It added Wriothesley (5-star Cryo Catalyst) and Neuvillette (5-star Hydro Catalyst) and continued Fontaine's Archon Quest with Acts III and IV.

Both acts take place largely in the Fortress of Meropide, the underwater prison that Wriothesley administers. The search for the missing Childe leads to a failing sluice gate that holds back the Primordial Sea.

Neuvillette's secret, that he is the Hydro Sovereign, is first shown at the end of Act IV, and the Traveler is asked to keep it quiet. The giant creature Childe meets in the Primordial Sea is first glimpsed in the final scene.

New content: New areas: the Liffey Region and the Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering Region. New weapons: Tome of the Eternal Flow and Cashflow Supervision (both 5-star Catalysts).

Banners ran as Decree of the Deeps (Neuvillette), Moment of Bloom (Hu Tao), Tempestuous Destiny (Wriothesley) and Ballad in Goblets (Venti). Four-star weapons were The Dockhand's Assistant, Portable Power Saw, Prospector's Drill, Range Gauge and Ballad of the Boundless Blue.

Neuvillette's Story Quest, Diluvies Chapter Act I - The Remains of the Past Day, and Wriothesley's, Cerberus Chapter Act I - Reborn in the Land of Grievances, arrived this version. The Adventure Encounters system and the weekly Sennight Gauntlet (replacing the Guest Challenge) were added, and the Fountain of Lucine level cap rose to 30.

Limited-time events included Waterborne Poetry, Dodoco's Bomb-Tastic Adventure, Radiant Harvest, The Peaks and Troughs of Life and The Forge Realm's Temper: Clever Strategems. World quest chains included the Fontaine Research Institute Chronicles.

Story: Archon Quest Chapter IV, Act III (To the Stars Shining in the Depths) and Act IV (Cataclysm's Quickening).

Childe has vanished from the Fortress of Meropide, so Neuvillette arranges for the Traveler and Paimon to be sentenced on false charges to 45 days there and investigate quietly. Inside, they meet the administrator Wriothesley, the head nurse Sigewinne and the prison's strange "hidden rules", and they find that Lyney, Lynette and Freminet are also looking for Childe. Freminet nearly dies from Primordial Seawater in the flooded tunnel Childe used.

Wriothesley shows the Traveler a sluice gate in the forbidden zone. It holds back the Primordial Sea and its gauge has been rising for a year. He explains the fortress began as a place where Egeria, the previous Hydro Archon, let repentant exiles guard her secret. When the gate fails, Wriothesley and Clorinde hold it briefly until Neuvillette arrives, pushes the water back and reseals it. Meanwhile Arlecchino, at a tea meeting with Furina that the Traveler attends, learns Furina does not hold the Hydro Gnosis.

Arlecchino tells the Traveler she once sought the Gnosis from Furina directly and found no Gnosis and no real threat. After the seal holds, Neuvillette confirms to the Traveler and Paimon that he is the Hydro Sovereign and explains that the First Usurper took part of the Seven Sovereigns' power to make the Archons' Authorities. He says he cannot stop the prophecy unless the Hydro Archon returns his Authority. The act ends with Childe drifting in the Primordial Sea and waking beneath a massive narwhal.

Characters introduced: Wriothesley is the administrator of the Fortress of Meropide, called the Duke. Neuvillette is the chief justice of Fontaine. Sigewinne is the prison's head nurse. Wriothesley first appears in this version; Neuvillette was already seen in 4.0.

Placement: Follows 4.0 and precedes 4.2.

Act III picks up days after the Act II verdicts. The Fortress of Meropide, the sluice gate and Neuvillette's identity are 4.1 reveals and are not known to anyone who has only seen 4.0.

143.content:
Version 4.2: Masquerade of the Guilty (also: Version 4.2, Genshin Impact 4.2, 4.2 update): Version 4.2, "Masquerade of the Guilty", was released on 2023-11-08. It added Furina (5-star Hydro Sword) and Charlotte (4-star Cryo Catalyst) and the Archon Quest finale of Fontaine's prophecy, Chapter IV Act V.

Act V is a trial of the Hydro Archon: Furina is put in the dock and found guilty of not being the Archon. The act then reveals what the prophecy actually meant and ends with the sacrifice of the true Archon Focalors.

New content: New areas: the Erinnyes Forest and the Morte Region. New weapons: Splendor of Tranquil Waters (5-star Sword) and Sword of Narzissenkreuz (4-star Sword).

Banners ran as Chanson of Many Waters (Furina and Charlotte), Immaculate Pulse (Baizhu and Charlotte), Twilight Arbiter (Cyno) and Azure Excursion (Kamisato Ayato). Furina's Story Quest, Animula Choragi Chapter Act I - "The Little Oceanid", arrived this version.

Limited-time events included Thelxie's Fantastic Adventures, Lil' Fungi's Fun-Tastic Fiesta, Graph Adversarial Technology Experiment Log and Misty Dungeon: Realm of Water. New books included La Chanson d'Erinnyes, Tales of a Snow-Winged Goose and The Fall of the Faded Castle. A new Xenochromatic Ball Octopus was added.

Quality-of-life changes included a higher custom map-marker limit (200) with batch deletion, a Trounce Domain Quick Challenge from Adventure Rank 40, a Lower Difficulty option for quest domains, Fountain of Lucine level 40, and TCG deck-sharing codes.

Story: Archon Quest Chapter IV, Act V: Masquerade of the Guilty.

After the Poisson flood, which dissolves people on the lower levels, including Navia's companions Melus and Silver, the Traveler helps Neuvillette force Furina onto the stage of the Opera Epiclese. The Traveler prosecutes her as a fraud, and when diluted Primordial Seawater affects her like any Fontainian, she is judged not to be the Hydro Archon. Yet the Oratrice still returns a death sentence for the Hydro Archon.

A recovered stone slate shows Egeria turning Oceanids into humans using the Primordial Sea, which is why the Fontainians dissolve when exposed to it and why Celestia punishes the Hydro Archon and her people. Neuvillette notes the fourth slate foretells a coming creature, which then rises from a rift: the giant narwhal seen in Childe's dream. Childe, in his Foul Legacy form, helps push it back.

In a realm opened by Furina's tear, the Traveler and Neuvillette meet Focalors, the true Archon, who explains that she was herself a transformed Oceanid and that she split her divinity from her human body, Furina, to outwit the Heavenly Principles. She cursed Furina so that she could not die while Focalors' divinity existed, and Furina played her part for 500 years, and now executes herself to return the Authority to Neuvillette. Neuvillette absolves all Fontainians so the Primordial Sea no longer dissolves them. Skirk then appears, hurls the weakened narwhal and Childe into a rift, and talks of Surtalogi and others "pursuing perfection". Afterwards the people are unharmed by the flood, Furina steps away from being Archon, and the Hydro Gnosis is handed to Arlecchino for the Tsaritsa. Skirk calls the Gnosis the remains of a third Descender.

Characters introduced: Furina is Fontaine's celebrated public Archon and, as Act V shows, a human who has played that role for five centuries. Charlotte is a reporter for the Steambird who has appeared since 4.0 and became playable here. Focalors, the true Archon, appears only briefly.

Skirk, Childe's master, appears for the first time in person at the end of Act V. Mona and the mage "N" appear in short scenes.

Placement: Follows 4.1 and precedes 4.3.

Act V closes the Fontaine Archon Quest apart from the epilogue (Act VI) released in 4.7. Anything that treats Furina as a god is set before the end of Act V.

144.content:
Version 4.3: Roses and Muskets (also: Version 4.3, Genshin Impact 4.3, 4.3 update): Version 4.3, "Roses and Muskets", was released on 2023-12-20. It added Navia (5-star Geo Claymore) and Chevreuse (4-star Pyro Polearm). It has no new region and no Archon Quest.

Its centrepiece is the limited-time Fontinalia film-festival event. The version follows the Archon Quest finale of 4.2 and has no main-story chapter of its own.

New content: New weapons: Verdict (5-star Claymore) and Ultimate Overlord's Mega Magic Sword (4-star Claymore, an event reward). New artifact sets: Nighttime Whispers in the Echoing Woods and Song of Days Past.

Banners ran as In the Name of the Rosula (Navia), The Heron's Court (Kamisato Ayaka), Reign of Serenity (Raiden Shogun and Chevreuse) and Tapestry of Golden Flames (Yoimiya and Chevreuse). Navia's Story Quest, Rosa Multiflora Chapter Act I - Braving the Tides Together, arrived this version.

A new domain, Waterfall Wen, was added, along with the Swirling Isles Serenitea Pot layout, a new book called The Two Musketeers and the item "Swirling Scene in a Bottle". Quality-of-life additions included a Recommended Sets function and Artifact Auto-Lock.

Other limited-time events included Arataki Blazing Armor Beetle Battle Boot Camp, Lost Riches, Dance of Resolute Will, Marvelous Merchandise and Gazing Up at Eternity, Looking Down at the World.

Event: Roses and Muskets was a flagship event, running from 2023-12-21 to 2024-01-08, with its shop open until 2024-01-15.

The Traveler and Paimon join the Fontinalia Film Festival. The filmmaker Xavier loses an investor and the group, including Chiori, Ayaka, Ayato and Yoimiya, recruit Furina as director for a film of "The Two Musketeers" and consult Chevreuse on muskets. Its four story acts were followed by an afterword.

The acts were titled The Crack of Muskets Breaking the Silence, Fiction and Reality Inside and Outside the Frame, The Lone Isle Glimpsed Through Fog, Where the Roses Bloom, and an afterword The Two Musketeers' Triumph. The four gameplay modes were the Thousand-Pace Interdiction Arcminute Sharpshooting Zone, Trick Shots Tricky Lights, Xtreme Drive and Into the Frame. The event reward weapon is Ultimate Overlord's Mega Magic Sword.

The recommended prerequisites were Archon Quest Chapter IV Act V, Furina's Animula Choragi Chapter Act I and the Raiden Shogun's Imperatrix Umbrosa Chapter Act II.

Placement: Follows 4.2 and precedes 4.4.

The event is a limited-time story, so characters should know of it only if they took part or heard about it.

145.comment: Version 4.4: Vibrant Harriers Aloft in Spring Breeze
145.content:
Version 4.4: Vibrant Harriers Aloft in Spring Breeze (also: Version 4.4, Genshin Impact 4.4): Version 4.4, "Vibrant Harriers Aloft in Spring Breeze", was released on 2024-01-31. It opened Chenyu Vale, a new mountain-and-river area of Liyue, and added Xianyun (5-star Anemo Catalyst) and Gaming (4-star Pyro Claymore). It had no Archon Quest.

The new area centres on tea-growing settlements such as Qiaoying Village and the port of Yilong Wharf, and ties into old Liyue adepti stories.

Contents: New characters: Xianyun ("Passerine Herald", 5-star Anemo Catalyst) and Gaming ("Leonine Vanguard", 4-star Pyro Claymore). New weapon: Crane's Echoing Call (5-star Catalyst). New area: Chenyu Vale, with Chenyu Vale: Upper Vale, Chenyu Vale: Southern Mountain and Mt. Laixin. Event wishes: The Crane Soars Skyward (Xianyun and Gaming) and The Moongrass' Enlightenment (Nahida and Gaming) in phase I; Invitation to Mundane Life (Xiao) and Everbloom Violet (Yae Miko) in phase II.

Named locations: Qiaoying Village, Yilong Wharf, Jademouth, Mt. Lingmeng, Yaodie Valley, Mt. Xuanlian and Chizhang Wall. New outfits: Frostflower Dew (Shenhe), Twilight Blossom (Ganyu) and Bamboo Rain (Xingqiu). New enemies were the Solitary Suanni and Xuanwen Beast. The Rainjade's Benediction system and the Chenyu Adeptea material were added.

Quests: Xianyun's Story Quest Grus Serena Chapter Act I, "A Thousand Moonlit Miles", and World Quests including the Chenyu's Blessings of Sunken Jade chain, "The Cloud-Padded Path to the Chiwang Repose", "Threefold Expectations", "A Wangshan Walk to Remember", "The Roaming Abode" and "Qiaoying, the Village of Many Tales". Events included Vibrant Harriers Aloft in Spring Breeze, Of Kites and New Sights, Receiver of Friends From Afar, Journey Through Hilinigmatic Terrain and Triumphant Frenzy. A Fast Equip option for artifacts was added as a system feature.

Story: Chenyu Vale lies around Mt. Yaojun and was once under an unnamed mistress who presided over wild spirits and animals; during the Archon War she fought Morax, and the adepti Fujin, Lingyuan and the Herblord sided against her flood plan. Many present-day inhabitants descend from refugees who fled the Chasm at the time of the cataclysm. In the present the suanni adeptus Lingyuan tampers with the vale's spirit lines, tainting the soil and water and the village's tea, until the Traveler helps Fujin restore balance.

Fujin, a golden carp adeptus, spends much of her power to undo the damage and returns to her carp form afterward. Xianyun's Story Quest "A Thousand Moonlit Miles" begins with the Traveler and Paimon visiting Mt. Aocang, where Xianyun, here in human form, explains she is visiting her disciples Ganyu and Shenhe, and Ganyu suggests the human name that she adopts.

Placement: Follows 4.3 and precedes 4.5. Chenyu Vale's history draws on events set far before the game's present (the Archon War), while the present-day quest chain happens in Liyue.

146.content: Version 4.4 (2024-01-31): Chenyu Vale opens in Liyue, with Xianyun and Gaming as new characters and no Archon Quest.

147.content:
Version 4.5: Blades Weaving Betwixt Brocade (also: Version 4.5, Genshin Impact 4.5, 4.5 update): Version 4.5, "Blades Weaving Betwixt Brocade", was released on 2024-03-13. It added Chiori (5-star Geo Sword), the owner of Chioriya Boutique in Fontaine. It has no new region and no Archon Quest.

The version is built around Chiori's own Story Quest and a Mondstadt-based alchemy event. Its official tagline pairs a booming potion trade in Mondstadt with Chiori's unorthodox work in fashion.

New content: New weapons: Uraku Misugiri (5-star Sword) and Dialogues of the Desert Sages (4-star Polearm, an event reward). A new book, Perinheri, was added.

Banners ran as Of Silken Clouds Woven (Chiori), Oni's Royale (Arataki Itto), Ode to the Dawn Breeze (a Chronicled Wish for Mondstadt characters and weapons), Decree of the Deeps (Neuvillette) and Leaves in the Wind (Kaedehara Kazuha).

Chiori's Story Quest is Cisoria Chapter Act I - When They Talk About Tonight, and the Lynette Hangout Event is Act I - Checks & Cats. A Training Guide function was added, offering build suggestions from recently active players.

Other limited-time events included Feline Fortress Furrdyssey, Rolling Crossfire and The Great Fayz Reaction Debate.

Story content: Chiori's Story Quest is about the owner of Chioriya Boutique, called "The Thundering Seamstress".

The quest is listed as requiring the Fontaine Archon Quest Act V first. The official blurb describes her as hard to read, a designer whose blades slice fabric as if only one choice existed.

Event: Alchemical Ascension was a flagship event running from 2024-03-14 to 2024-04-01.

Set in Mondstadt, it has Lisa invite the Traveler and Paimon to help the Knights of Favonius promote alchemy. Players cultivate ingredients, concoct potions and sell them to grow a shop. Its recommended prerequisites were Archon Quest Chapter IV Act V and Eula's Story Quest Aphros Delos Chapter Act I.

Its three gameplay strands were Cultivating Ingredients, Concocting Potions and Selling Potions; the reward weapon was Dialogues of the Desert Sages.

Placement: Follows 4.4 and precedes 4.6.

This version has no Archon Quest. Its events are limited-time, so characters should know of them only if they took part.
