148.comment: Version 4.6: Two Worlds Aflame, the Crimson Night Fades
148.content:
Version 4.6: Two Worlds Aflame, the Crimson Night Fades (also: Version 4.6, Genshin Impact 4.6, 4.6 update): Version 4.6, "Two Worlds Aflame, the Crimson Night Fades", was released on 2024-04-24. It added Arlecchino (5-star Pyro Polearm) and two new areas in Fontaine: the Sea of Bygone Eras and the Nostoi Region. It has no Archon Quest.

The exploration content is the ancient civilisation Remuria, which preceded Egeria's rule. The Faded Castle, once home to the Harmosts and scholars of Remuria, leads down to the deeper ruins. Arlecchino's own Story Quest arrives with the version.

New content: New weapon: Crimson Moon's Semblance (5-star Polearm). New artifact sets: Unfinished Reverie and Fragment of Harmonic Whimsy.

Banners ran as The Hearth's Ashen Shadow (Arlecchino), Conjuring Chiaroscuro (Lyney), From Ashes Reborn (Wanderer) and Immaculate Pulse (Baizhu). Arlecchino's Story Quest is Ignis Purgatorius Chapter Act I - When the Hearth-Flame Goes Out. The Lupus Aureus Chapter Act II - Oathkeeper, a Story Quest for Cyno, also released.

New domains were Faded Theater and Scattered Ruins. New exploration features included the Mysterious Grimoire, Washer Octopus, and the Wonderchime Flowers and Allochromatic Anemones. The Focused Experience Mode was added, first for Arlecchino's quest, and the Fountain of Lucine cap rose to level 50, after which Hydro Sigils can be exchanged with Mequignon.

World quests included For Yesterday and Tomorrow, Latecoming Homecoming, Where His Life Lies and Daydreams Beyond Space and Time. Limited-time events included Windtrace: Seekers and Strategy, Specially-Shaped Saurian Search, Vibro-Crystal Applications and a Rockin' tour event with Arataki Itto.

Areas: The Nostoi Region sits off the main Fontaine plate, so its waters cannot be dived into. The Sea of Bygone Eras is a separate map reached from the Faded Castle.

The Sea of Bygone Eras has its own map tab and exploration progress and unlocks after completing the Underwater Nocturne quest. Its in-game text calls it the undersea capital and lost homeland and says its long-forgotten symphony sounds once more. Petrichor and the Faded Castle are within the Nostoi Region, and the Faded Castle is first reached during The Shadow Over Petrichor.

Remuria was founded by the god Remus, called the God King, with Capitolium as its capital and a golden bee as its emblem. It fell after Remus tried to avert its prophesied destruction by sharing power with four human Harmosts; the empire sank with its people and its god. The History of the Decline and Fall of Remuria records the story.

Story content: Arlecchino's quest follows an "aftershadow" in the House of the Hearth.

The official quest blurb describes a shadow that should not exist wandering the House of the Hearth's halls, bringing goodwill and hastening ill deeds. It requires the Archon Quest Act V as a prerequisite. Cyno's Act II is set in Sumeru City and concerns a case tied to a mysterious organization.

Placement: Follows 4.5 and precedes 4.7.

Characters who have not explored Nostoi or the Sea of Bygone Eras may know Remuria only from rumours and books.

149.content:
Version 4.7: An Everlasting Dream Intertwined (also: Version 4.7, Genshin Impact 4.7, 4.7 update): Version 4.7, "An Everlasting Dream Intertwined", was released on 2024-06-05. It added Clorinde (5-star Electro Sword), Sigewinne (5-star Hydro Bow) and Sethos (4-star Electro Bow), and the Imaginarium Theater. It finished Archon Quest Chapter IV with Act VI, Bedtime Story.

Act VI is an epilogue set in Sumeru, not Fontaine. The Traveler takes a commission to find a villager whom nobody remembers well, and meets Dainsleif and then Caribert. The Traveler's sibling appears in a memory.

New content: New weapons: Absolution (5-star Sword), Silvershower Heartstrings (5-star Bow) and Cloudforged (4-star Bow). No new region was added.

Banners ran as Illuminating Lightning (Clorinde and Sethos), Caution in Confidence (Alhaitham and Sethos), Romaritime Meluserenity (Sigewinne) and Chanson of Many Waters (Furina). Clorinde's Story Quest is Rapperia Chapter Act I - Silent Night, and Sigewinne's is Nereides Chapter Act I - The Warmth of Lies.

Imaginarium Theater, a permanent combat challenge in the Theater Lobby in Mondstadt, opens at Adventure Rank 35 after the world quest Unbegun, Unending Story. Characters have limited Vigor and the season picks three elements as the main cast. Events included Mutual Security Enhancing Simulation, Endless Forms Most Martial, Spino Doubleblaster and Record of Reflective Writing.

Story: Archon Quest Chapter IV, Act VI: Bedtime Story. It follows three quests: Cold Case Commission, Memories That Should Not Exist and World-Order Narration.

A joint commission from the people of Vimara Village asks for a missing man whom none of them can name. Atossa remembers sitting with him at dusk beneath a tree, when the sun never seemed to move. Dainsleif is also investigating the Abyss Order and tells the Traveler that the mysterious voice from their last meeting belongs to his elder brother, Vedrfolnir, one of the Five Sinners of Khaenri'ah.

Dainsleif suspects the missing man has the power to implant memories, and that the Abyss Order is hunting the eye of the first Field Tiller. The Traveler and Paimon are sent back to the village while Dainsleif faces the Traveler's sibling, who holds a golden sword and wants a duel first. The missing man is Caribert, who says his father told him he was the foundation of the Loom of Fate. He built the false memories himself to have a chance at the life he was denied.

Caribert explains that the Loom of Fate began as a device that could create and implant memories and, when fully unlocked, creates Ley Lines of its own and can change the world. He says the Loom has been completed. The Traveler meets the sibling inside his memory but cannot touch them. The sibling says they are racing to unlock the Loom before the Heavenly Principles awaken, since those did not stir even after the Hydro throne was destroyed. The Traveler forgets the conversation on waking and finds only a photo of the three of them. The villagers remember Caribert as someone who left with two others.

Characters introduced: Clorinde is Fontaine's strongest Champion Duelist and has been in the story since 4.0. Sigewinne is the Fortress of Meropide's head nurse. Sethos is new in this version. Caribert appears only in Bedtime Story.

Placement: Follows 4.6 and precedes 4.8.

Bedtime Story takes place after Masquerade of the Guilty and is the first Chapter IV act set outside Fontaine. Details of the sibling's goals and the Loom of Fate should not be known to the Traveler's companions who were not present.

150.content:
Version 4.8: Summertide Scales and Tales (also: Version 4.8, Genshin Impact 4.8, 4.8 update): Version 4.8, "Summertide Scales and Tales", was released on 2024-07-17. It added Emilie (5-star Dendro Polearm) and the limited-time summer event in Simulanka. It has no Archon Quest and is the last version before Natlan in 5.0.

The version has no main-story chapter; its story content is the limited-time event and Emilie's Story Quest.

New content: New weapon: Lumidouce Elegy (5-star Polearm). Emilie's Story Quest is Pomum de Ambra Chapter Act I - Floral Debt, Blood Due.

Banners ran as In the Name of the Rosula (Navia), Twirling Lotus (Nilou), Ambrosial Essence (Emilie) and Discerner of Enigmas (Yelan). The official blurb for Emilie's quest says the legendary flower Auguste, once popular in Fontaine, was lost in a fire and rumours of it returning in Sumeru draw people to Port Ormos.

The Imaginarium Theater gained Envisaged Echoes, Adventure Encounters gained Longer-Term Encounter Points, and a Hide UI function and a Dialogue Review screen were added. Other limited-time events were Bing-Bang Finchball, Outside the Canvas, Inside the Lens: Dew-Kissed Chapter and Energy Amplifier: Lemma.

Event: Summertide Scales and Tales was a flagship event running from 2024-07-17 to 2024-08-28, set in the limited-time area Simulanka.

Simulanka is a world created by Alice, Barbeloth and Andersdotter of the Hexenzirkel, whom its people call the Goddesses of Creation, Prophecy and Fate. Alice brought the Traveler, Paimon, Nilou, Kirara, Navia and the Wanderer there to experience its story. Visions do not work in Simulanka.

Its subareas include the Forest of Blessings, the Constellation Metropole and the Broken Sea. The story ran in Page I, Page II and Page III with an Appendix, plus limited-time world quests such as The Lotus Leaf and the Champion and The Forest and the Princess. The gameplay modes were Boreal Flurry, Flying Hatter's Trick, Metropole Trials and Figurine Fabrication. Kirara could be invited to the team from the event.

The wiki recommends having finished Interlude Chapter Act III and Chapter IV Act V first.

Placement: Follows 4.7 and precedes 5.0.

Version 4.8 closes the 4.x series. Characters should know the event only if they took part.

key: Version 5.0: Flowers Resplendent on the Sun-Scorched Sojourn
151.comment: Version 5.0: Flowers Resplendent on the Sun-Scorched Sojourn
151.content:
Version 5.0: Flowers Resplendent on the Sun-Scorched Sojourn (also: Version 5.0, Genshin Impact 5.0, Natlan release): Version 5.0, "Flowers Resplendent on the Sun-Scorched Sojourn", was released on 2024-08-28. It opened Natlan, the Pyro nation, as a new nation, and began Chapter V of the Archon Quest. New characters were Mualani, Kinich and Kachina.

It follows Version 4.8 and precedes 5.1. The version added four Natlan subregions (the Basin of Unnumbered Flames, Coatepec Mountain, Tequemecan Valley and Toyac Springs) and the Chapter V Archon Quest Acts I and II.

Natlan arrived with its own set of systems: Saurian Indwelling, Phlogiston, Nightsoul's Blessing, Tribe Reputation and the Tablet of Tona. A parallel event of the same title as Act I, run during the version, is separate from the Archon Quest.

The version also introduced World Level 9 (reachable at Adventure Rank 58), the Artifact Transmuter and a revised Character Event Wish mechanic called Capturing Radiance.

Release: Released 2024-08-28, between 4.8 and 5.1.

Phase I banners were Sharktacular Surfari (Mualani and Kachina) and Leaves in the Wind (Kaedehara Kazuha and Kachina). Phase II brought Seeker of Flame-Wrought Secrets (Kinich) and Reign of Serenity (the Raiden Shogun).

New five-star weapons on the event banner were Fang of the Mountain King (Claymore) and Surf's Up (Catalyst). Forgeable four-star weapons were Flute of Ezpitzal, Earth Shaker, Footprint of the Rainbow, Ring of Yaxche and Chain Breaker, and the event weapon Ash-Graven Drinking Horn. New artifact sets were Obsidian Codex and Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City.

Imaginarium Theater's first season of the version opened on 2024-09-01 (Pyro, Hydro and Dendro required) and the second on 2024-10-01 (Pyro, Electro and Geo). New bosses included the Gluttonous Yumkasaur Mountain King and the Goldflame Qucusaur Tyrant. Players could also salvage unenhanced artifacts into Sanctifying materials, and the maximum Fate Points for the Epitomized Path weapon banner fell from 2 to 1.

Characters: Mualani ("Splish-Splash Wavechaser") is a five-star Hydro Catalyst character. Kinich ("Turnfire Hunt") is a five-star Dendro Claymore character. Kachina ("Mottled Gold Yet Unsmelted") is a four-star Geo Polearm character. Their own files carry the profiles.

The permanent event Turbo Twirly!, unlocked by progressing Act I of the Archon Quest, lets the player invite Kachina. The namecards were Mualani: Sharky, Kinich: Ajaw and Kachina: Twirly.

Archon quest: Chapter V Act I, also titled Flowers Resplendent on the Sun-Scorched Sojourn, has the quests Natlan! A New Adventure, Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame and Home of the Hot Springs. Act II, Black Stone Under a White Stone, has A Decision, To Reclaim an Ancient Name, Echoes of Life, Into Eternal Night and Past and Future. Both need Adventure Rank 40, and Act I could be started at rank 28 through a quick start after A New Star Approaches.

Act I shows the Traveler and Paimon reaching Natlan, meeting Kachina, Mualani and Kinich, watching the Pilgrimage and visiting Mualani's village, where Atea is mortally wounded by the Abyss. In Act II the Night Warden Wars are won, but Kachina is not found in the Sacred Flame. The Traveler and friends go into the Night Kingdom to recover her. The Fatui Harbinger Capitano appears, challenges Mavuika and is wounded.

At the act's close, Mavuika gives up much of her power to keep the Sacred Flame lit and reveals a plan to find six warriors whose Names the Wayob will acknowledge. Mavuika also tells the Traveler she will have an Ancient Name forged for them. Rezanov, a Fatui under Capitano, asks whether to take the Pyro Gnosis from her weakened state; Capitano refuses, saying he respects her win and will not use dishonourable means.

New region: Natlan's four launch subregions were the Basin of Unnumbered Flames, Coatepec Mountain, Tequemecan Valley and Toyac Springs. Story quests in the Tribal Chronicles series introduced three of the tribes: the People of the Springs, the Scions of the Canopy and the Children of Echoes.

The series' acts were Where the Springs Return, Yupanqui's Turnfire and A Prayer for Blessings, Told to Crested Peaks (Acts I and II). New enemies include Secret Source Automatons, Avatars of Lava, Wayob Manifestations and Sauroform tribal warriors, with Koholasaurs, Tepetlisaurs and Yumkasaurs as the first Saurian companions.

Wildlife added includes the capybara, alpaca, red flamingo and Pyro Crystalfly. Books added include Maawe and Monetoo, Records of Hanan Pacha, The Tale of Qoyllor and Ukuku and The Volcano Lord and the Shadow Pins.

152.comment: Version 5.0: Flowers Resplendent on the Sun-Scorched Sojourn: Tribal Chronicles
152.content:
The Story Quest series that gives each Natlan tribe its own chapter. Version 5.0 opened three: People of the Springs (Where the Springs Return, Acts I to III), Scions of the Canopy (Yupanqui's Turnfire, Acts I to III) and Children of Echoes (A Prayer for Blessings, Told to Crested Peaks, Acts I and II).

Later versions continued the series: Act III of the Children of Echoes chapter in 5.1, Tlalocan and Mictlan in 5.2, and Teteocan in 5.5.

key: Version 5.1: The Rainbow Destined to Burn
153.comment: Version 5.1: The Rainbow Destined to Burn
153.content:
Version 5.1: The Rainbow Destined to Burn (also: Version 5.1, Genshin Impact 5.1): Version 5.1, "The Rainbow Destined to Burn", was released on 2024-10-09. It added no new region. Its main content was Chapter V Acts III and IV of the Archon Quest and one new character, the five-star Geo Sword user Xilonen.

It follows Version 5.0 and precedes 5.2. The two acts turn the story from a Pilgrimage tournament into an open war: the Fatui Harbinger Capitano pursues a plan of his own and the Abyss launches a nationwide invasion.

Act III is about an Ancient Name for the Traveler and a hunt for Ororon, who has joined the Fatui. Act IV is a six-quest act that ends with the Abyss invasion repelled and with Mavuika's price for her victory unresolved.

A separate event with the same title as Act IV ran during the version. It is distinct from the Archon Quest act.

Release: Released 2024-10-09, between 5.0 and 5.2.

Phase I banners were Forgefire's Blessing (Xilonen) and Of Silken Clouds Woven (Chiori). Phase II banners were The Moongrass' Enlightenment (Nahida) and Moment of Bloom (Hu Tao).

The new five-star weapon was Peak Patrol Song (Sword), with the four-star Sturdy Bone (Sword), Mountain-Bracing Bolt (Polearm) and Fruitful Hook (Claymore). Events included Chromatic Ode of Candies and Roses, Feast of Pursuit, Reminiscent Regimen: Thrill, Aphid Treasure Trace, Marvelous Merchandise and a Tribal Chronicles event. The Imaginarium Theater season opened on 2024-11-01.

New enemies were the Secret Source Automaton: Configuration Device and the Tenebrous Mimiflora. Spiral Abyss updated on 2024-10-16 and 2024-11-16, with a skip function that lets a player claim lower floors' rewards after clearing higher ones. Genius Invokation TCG added Chiori and Eremite Floral Ring-Dancer cards.

Characters: Xilonen ("Ardent Flames Forge the Soul") is a five-star Geo Sword character. Her own file carries her profile.

Namecards were Xilonen: Cue Point and Travel Notes: Sabzeruz. Her specialty dish is Fruit-Flavored Milk Candies.

Archon quest: Act III, Beyond the Smoke and Mirrors, has the quests All Names are Noble, To Whence the Smoke Drifts and The Flickering Light Splits in Twain. Act IV, The Rainbow Destined to Burn, has Beneath the Secret Source, As One We Watch the Setting Sun, The Surging Darkness, Despair Engulfs the Heavens, No One Fights Alone and A Fuel Named "Fate". Both need Adventure Rank 40.

Act III: Xilonen is set to forge the Traveler a Name, which no outsider has ever had. Citlali agrees to help if they prove Ororon, a member of her tribe, has not truly sided with the Fatui. Capitano meets the Traveler through Ororon and warns that Mavuika's plan may not be enough, and the Abyss then attacks the whole nation at once. Act IV: Capitano and Ororon use a device from the Secret Source to wake the Lord of the Night. Mavuika persuades Capitano to join an alliance, an Abyssal invasion follows and ends only when six heroes stand with their Archon.

Capitano explains that his plan, to rebuild the Ley Lines, would erase the Night Kingdom's memory of Natlan, and Mavuika refuses because it would be no different from using the Gnosis. Chuychu, Chasca's adoptive younger sister, is infected by Abyssal energy and dies, at which point Chasca's Ancient Name appears and she becomes the sixth hero. Mavuika declares a Night Warden War in which the Ode of Resurrection protects everyone. The act closes with her using the power of Ronova, the Ruler of Death, which means she is slated to die, and with the Traveler's Name still unfinished. Capitano also reveals himself to be a survivor of Khaenri'ah.

The invasion: The Abyss answers Ororon's awakening by dropping tumours across the nation, flooding Natlan with pylons and monsters. Several tribes fall back to the Stadium of the Sacred Flame, with the Flower-Feather Clan and the Scions of the Canopy hit hardest. The war ends when Mavuika and the six heroes destroy the tumours and the rift at the stadium.

Mavuika's attack briefly exposes a false sky, which no one at the time pays much attention to. After the victory the Natlanese hold a feast, mourn the dead and plan a funeral for the fallen.

154.comment: Version 5.1: The Rainbow Destined to Burn: Source Mechanism
154.content:
A device from the Secret Source that Capitano and Ororon located with the help of three scholars, hoping to use it to rebuild Natlan's Ley Lines. When it was activated it woke Yohualtecuhtin, the Lord of the Night, who explained it was the source of the nation's Ley Lines.

The Lord of the Night says the dragons once used it to strengthen the Ley Lines but could not work with their intricate structure, and that the Night Kingdom was built from fragments of the old lines after the Descender fought the dragons. She offers to rebuild the lines at the cost of her own existence, an offer Mavuika refuses.

key: Version 5.2: Tapestry of Spirit and Flame
155.comment: Version 5.2: Tapestry of Spirit and Flame
155.content:
Version 5.2: Tapestry of Spirit and Flame (also: Version 5.2, Genshin Impact 5.2): Version 5.2, "Tapestry of Spirit and Flame", was released on 2024-11-20. It added three Natlan areas, the Interlude Archon Quest of Chapter V, All Fires Fuel the Flame, and two characters: Chasca, a five-star Anemo Bow user, and Ororon, a four-star Electro Bow user. It was also the first version to support Xbox Series X and S and Xbox Game Pass.

It follows Version 5.1 and precedes 5.3. The new areas are Tezcatepetonco Range, Quahuacan Cliff and Ochkanatlan. The Interlude is a one-quest story set after the invasion of 5.1, in which the Traveler helps a tribe recover from the war.

The Interlude sits between Act IV and Act V of Chapter V. Story quests added chapters for two more tribes, the Flower-Feather Clan (Tlalocan) and the Masters of the Night-Wind (Mictlan), and a Natlan Fishing Association.

Two more Saurian companions, the Qucusaur and the Iktomisaur, were added to the Saurian Indwelling system alongside Tribe Reputation for those two tribes.

Release: Released 2024-11-20, between 5.1 and 5.3.

Phase I banners were Piercing Shot's Crimson Wake (Chasca and Ororon) and Conjuring Chiaroscuro (Lyney and Ororon). Phase II banners were Decree of the Deeps (Neuvillette) and Gentry of Hermitage (Zhongli).

New weapons were the five-star bow Astral Vulture's Crimson Plumage and the four-star Flower-Wreathed Feathers (Bow), Waveriding Whirl (Catalyst) and Calamity of Eshu (Sword). Events included Iktomi Spiritseeking Scrolls, Adventurer's Trials: Metamorphosis, Exercise Surging Storm, Heated Battle Mode: Automatic Artistry, Claw Convoy and Of Fading Flowers and Falling Feathers.

A new boss, Tenebrous Papilla, arrived with Wayob Manifestations that burn or freeze and a set of Qucusaurus and Iktomisaurus warriors. The Natlan Fishing Association added fishing points. Spiral Abyss refreshed on 2024-12-16.

Characters: Chasca ("Skyborne Arbiter") is a five-star Anemo Bow character. Ororon ("Shadow of the Night-Wind") is a four-star Electro Bow character. Their own files carry the profiles.

Archon quest: Chapter V: Interlude, All Fires Fuel the Flame, has one quest, For the Same Land. It needs Adventure Rank 40.

After the war, Iansan and the Traveler help the Flower-Feather Clan, whose people were hit hardest. Three of the tribe's warriors are struggling with what they saw. Two recover once the Traveler and Iansan find a way to reach them, and the third, Ocotlan, who mistakes his own tribe for Abyssal monsters, has to be given the Draught of Lucidity to treat Abyssal Corrosion Syndrome.

Capitano appears to explain that syndrome and the cure, which was developed by his late second-in-command Guthred. He says Ronova is responsible for his people's suffering, then shows the Traveler his true face. The act ends with Xilonen beginning the Traveler's Name, which will need the Pilgrim's Chronicle and the Traveler's feats recounted in front of it.

New areas: The new areas are Tezcatepetonco Range, Quahuacan Cliff and Ochkanatlan. World quest chains include Lost Traveler in the Ashen Realm, Every Aspect of a Warrior and additions to In the Footsteps of the Chosen of Dragons.

The Tribal Chronicles added two chapters: Tlalocan, Of Fading Flowers and Falling Feathers (Acts I to III), and Mictlan, Memories Flowing With Color (Acts I and II). Act III of the latter came in 5.3.

156.comment: Version 5.2: Tapestry of Spirit and Flame: Abyssal Corrosion Syndrome
156.content: An illness that follows fighting the Abyss and can leave a warrior in hallucinations. Capitano says some cases ease through talk or contact, while severe ones need the Draught of Lucidity, which leaves the patient with lasting migraines.

157.content:
Version 5.3: Incandescent Ode of Resurrection (also: Version 5.3, Genshin Impact 5.3): Version 5.3, "Incandescent Ode of Resurrection", was released on 2025-01-01. It added no new region. Its main content was Chapter V Act V, which ends the Natlan war, and three new characters: Mavuika (five-star Pyro Claymore), Citlali (five-star Cryo Catalyst) and Lan Yan (four-star Anemo Catalyst). It also gave the Traveler a Pyro form.

It follows Version 5.2 and precedes 5.4. In Act V the Traveler receives an Ancient Name, goes with Mavuika into the Night Kingdom to end the Abyss threat, and then helps decide what Natlan's victory will cost.

Mavuika's own Story Quest, Sol Invictus Chapter, began in this version with As the Blazing Sun, and the Tribal Chronicles chapter Memories Flowing With Color received its third act, The Truth of the Battle of Seven Colors.

The Archon Quest's final scenes point the Traveler towards Snezhnaya and Nod-Krai, the next regions of the story.

Release: Released 2025-01-01, between 5.2 and 5.4.

Phase I banners were Ancient Flame Ablaze (Mavuika) and Starry Night's Whispers (Citlali). Phase II banners were The Hearth's Ashen Shadow (Arlecchino and Lan Yan) and Illuminating Lightning (Clorinde and Lan Yan), and a Chronicled Wish named Remembrance of Jade and Stone.

New five-star weapons were A Thousand Blazing Suns (Claymore) and Starcaller's Watch (Catalyst). Outfits were Cherries Snow-Laden (Hu Tao) and New Year's Cheer (Xiangling). A new Serenitea Pot realm layout, Tletl Ilhuicatl, was unlocked with the Scroll of the Fiery Firmament.

Imaginarium Theater's first season of the version opened on 2025-02-01 (Pyro, Hydro and Anemo required). The Repertoire of Myriad Melodies music system and the gadgets Ukulele and Djem Djem Drum arrived. Spiral Abyss refreshed on 2025-01-16.

Events: Limited-time events of the version included Springtime Charms with its Lantern-Lit Gathering, May Fortune Find You: Spring's Premonition, Emblem of Steadfast Valor and On the Trail of Behemoths. They ran only during the version and are not universal knowledge.

The Eight Adepts masks and plum-branch furnishings released alongside are cosmetic items tied to the spring events.

Characters: Mavuika ("Night-Igniting Flame") is a five-star Pyro Claymore character and the Pyro Archon. Citlali ("Obsidian Opalstar") is a five-star Cryo Catalyst character. Lan Yan ("Spring Woven From Jade") is a four-star Anemo Catalyst character. Their own files carry the profiles.

The namecards were Mavuika: Sun-Crowned, Citlali: Opalstar and Lan Yan: Silver Swallow.

Archon quest: Chapter V Act V has five quests: Subterranean Ruins, As the Sun Rises and Sets, Journey of Stars and Flames, Where All Hopes Lie and When All Becomes a Monument. It needs Adventure Rank 40.

Xilonen finishes the Traveler's Ancient Name, Tumaini, which means hope. After a feast and a test of the Name, the Traveler and Mavuika enter the Night Kingdom to destroy the Abyssal core, fighting the dragon-like Gosoythoth with the help of spirits who guard the path. The Traveler receives Pyro power from the Lord of the Night during the fight. The Sacred Flame briefly goes out above, then the war is won.

Afterwards, Natlan celebrates the Traveler, and Chasca crowns them. Mavuika is still slated to die because she used the Ruler of Death's power. At the ruins of Ochkanatlan the Traveler and Citlali find a rift in the sky, and Ronova demands Mavuika's death as the price. Capitano arrives with Ororon and offers himself in her place, merging his life force with the Lord of the Night, using a curse-given immortality to put Ronova in an unresolvable paradox. Mavuika writes a letter to her sister Hine and burns it, and the Traveler leaves their crown at a new monument to the fallen.
Mavuika also tells the Traveler that Capitano had asked the Tsaritsa to cancel his mission to take the Pyro Gnosis and that the request was granted. She warns that entering Snezhnaya would put the Traveler in conflict with the Fatui, and says the Doctor's subordinates are investigating relics that appeared in the sky, with a stronghold in Nod-Krai.

158.comment: Version 5.3: Incandescent Ode of Resurrection: Pilgrim's Chronicle
158.content: A parchment made by the Lord of the Night that records the Traveler's deeds in Natlan, past and future, so that Xilonen can forge a Name for an outsider. It first recorded their help in Kachina's victory in the Pilgrimage.

159.content:
Version 5.4: Moonlight Amidst Dreams (also: Version 5.4, Update 5.4, Patch 5.4, Moonlight Amidst Dreams): Version 5.4, "Moonlight Amidst Dreams", was released on 2025-02-12. It added Yumemizuki Mizuki, a dream-eating baku who treats patients at the Aisa Bathhouse in Inazuma City, and her Story Quest "Dream Eater's Melancholia". It had no Archon Quest.

Mizuki's quest is the first act of the Tapirus Somniator Chapter and needs Chapter II Act III, "Transient Dreams" and Adventure Rank 40. The bathhouse is a Natlan-inspired spa that offers psychotherapy by baku staff.

The patch also launched the first Imaginarium Theater season of 2025 (on 2025-03-01), Genius Invokation TCG cards, a character specialty dish and Paimon's Paintings emoji set 38.

Contents: Character: Yumemizuki Mizuki (5-star Anemo catalyst). Weapons: Sunny Morning Sleep-In (5-star catalyst) and Tamayuratei no Ohanashi (4-star polearm). New location: Aisa Bathhouse (instance).

Banners: phase I "Dawn's Drifting Reverie" (Mizuki) and "Romaritime Meluserenity" (Sigewinne); phase II "Chanson of Many Waters" (Furina) and "Tempestuous Destiny" (Wriothesley). The character dish is "Dreams of Healing".

Events were Enchanted Tales of the Mikawa Festival, Travelers' Tales: Anthology Chapter, Realm of Tempered Valor, Invasive Fish Wrangler, Reel Ad-Venture, a Ley Line Overflow and Tapirus Somniator Chapter (Event), all limited-time. The first Imaginarium Theater season featured Mizuki as a guest star.

Story: On a night walk the Traveler and Paimon stumble into Mizuki's dream-eating. She is a baku, a youkai that feeds on dreams and nightmares, and works as a clinical psychologist and major investor at Aisa Bathhouse. The bathhouse is struggling financially while a rival psychotherapy clinic promises better results, and the Traveler investigates.

The rival is run by a man called Emura Ichigensai, really Emura Chuuya, a former patient. His clients feel only happiness, but their troubles are only hidden. The cause is Kuroyume, a nightmare monster possessing him. The Traveler and Mizuki enter his nightmare, fight Kuroyume, and rescue Chuuya from drowning. The baku then clear the nightmare bubbles over Narukami Island.

Yae Miko, a friend of Mizuki from before she became Guuji, secretly gives the Traveler Chuuya's address because she worries about her. Chuuya is saved but regresses to a young child's mind. Mizuki thanks Miko, saying her feelings of inferiority gave her the strength to persevere.

Placement: Follows 5.3 and precedes 5.5. The Aisa Bathhouse page says the bathhouse was renovated after the Natlan quest "Incandescent Ode of Resurrection", under Mizuki's direction.

160.comment: Version 5.4: Moonlight Amidst Dreams: Version 5.4 Aisa Bathhouse
160.content:
Aisa Bathhouse is an indoor bathhouse in Inazuma City, inspired by the hot springs of Natlan. It offers a spa, fine dining and psychotherapy from resident baku, including Mizuki. Its owner is Aikawa Susumu, who returned from Natlan, and its baku staff are Hyakujitsuhaku Shion and Shiba Murasaki. Many Tenryou Commission samurai visit.

Shion takes a food-based approach to therapy. Mizuki works to expand the brand to Watatsumi Island and Natlan. Treating bad dreams can leave baku in pain: Shion and Murasaki suffer indigestion after eating two clients' nightmares.

161.comment: Version 5.4: Moonlight Amidst Dreams: Version 5.4 Dream Eater's Melancholia
161.content:
Dream Eater's Melancholia has five quests: "Encounter in the Realm of Dreams", "Crisis at the Aisa Bathhouse", "A Deceit Called Happiness", "Descendant of Nightmares" and "Afterword". Mizuki explains that she cries during the last stage of digesting nightmares. She identifies nightmare monsters as the natural enemy of baku, and Kuroyume says he is the last of his kind.

Inside Chuuya's nightmare the Traveler sees fragments of his rejected ambitions to be a writer. In the borderland of Inazuma's collective subconscious, the Traveler offers a sweet dream to restore Mizuki's strength. Kuroyume survives wounded.

162.comment: Version 5.4: Moonlight Amidst Dreams: Version 5.4 New Character
162.content: Version 5.4 introduced Yumemizuki Mizuki ("Embrace of Enchanting Dreams"), a 5-star Anemo catalyst user and baku youkai. Her banner "Dawn's Drifting Reverie" was limited-time and may be rerun.

key: Version 5.5: Day of the Flame's Return
163.comment: Version 5.5: Day of the Flame's Return
163.content:
Version 5.5: Day of the Flame's Return (also: Version 5.5, Genshin Impact 5.5): Version 5.5, "Day of the Flame's Return", was released on 2025-03-26. It had no Archon Quest. It added two Natlan areas, Atocpan and the Ancient Sacred Mountain, and two characters: Varesa (five-star Electro Catalyst) and Iansan (four-star Electro Polearm).

It follows Version 5.4 and precedes 5.6. The version's main story was a Tribal Chronicles chapter for the Collective of Plenty, and its main event, Tournament of Glory in Bloom, staged war games between the six tribes.

Atocpan holds the Great Volcano of Tollan and the Collective of Plenty's home. The Ancient Sacred Mountain lies inside that volcano and holds the Sacred City of Tollan, capital of the ancient dragon civilisation.

The version also raised the level cap of the Tona's Flame system to 40 and added the Tatankasaur as a Saurian companion, the Land of Tleyaoyotl album, and the domain Derelict Masonry Dock.

Release: Released 2025-03-26, between 5.4 and 5.6.

Phase I banners were Cornucopia of Contention (Varesa and Iansan) and The Crane Soars Skyward (Xianyun and Iansan). Phase II banners were Forgefire's Blessing (Xilonen) and Ballad in Goblets (Venti).

The new five-star weapon was Vivid Notions (Catalyst), and the new artifact sets were Long Night's Oath and Finale of the Deep Galleries. World quest chains included A Finale Emberforged, Chronicler of the Crumbling City and Path to the Flaming Peaks.

Spiral Abyss refreshed on 2025-04-16. Genius Invokation TCG added Emilie and Kachina character cards. The hidden objectives included An Audience With the Nightsoul Pillar and Little Lost Saurians.

Characters: Varesa ("Strength in Serenity") is a five-star Electro Catalyst character. Iansan ("Tempered in Molten Stone") is a four-star Electro Polearm character. Their own files carry the profiles.

The namecards were Varesa: Powerhouse and Iansan: Unyielding.

Story: The Tribal Chronicles chapter for the Collective of Plenty is Mushroom Realm Mystery. In its first act the Traveler and Paimon meet Varesa near the Great Volcano of Tollan and she guides them to her tribe. In the second she shows them the tribe's camp and her family's orchard.

The chapter has three acts: Ardent Land of Plenty, Orchard Repose and Field Fungal Traces. The first two require the Pilgrimage quest from Act I of Chapter V, and the third needs Incandescent Ode of Resurrection.

Events: Limited-time events of the version included Tournament of Glory in Bloom, Quirky Quaking Arena, Rhythm Ball Meztli, Unlimited Fighting Championship, Overflowing Favor, The Sacred Mountain and Sanctified Land and a Mushroom Realm Mystery event. They ran only during the version and are not universal knowledge.

Tournament of Glory in Bloom ran 2025-03-28 to 2025-04-14 and unlocked the character Ororon as a reward. It had two modes: Bloomflower Trials, in which players fight war games between the six tribes, and Saurian Treasure Seeker, a route-planning game with Saurian whelps.

164.comment: Version 5.5: Day of the Flame's Return: Ancient Sacred Mountain
164.content: An area inside the Great Volcano of Tollan, containing the Sacred City of Tollan, the capital of the dragon civilisation that once ruled Natlan. It opens through the quest Nahuatzin's Leap, and its lower levels open as the quests progress.

165.content:
Version 5.6: Paralogism (also: Version 5.6, Genshin Impact 5.6): Version 5.6, "Paralogism", was released on 2025-05-07. It added no new area. Its main content was the Archon Quest Interlude Chapter Act IV, also titled Paralogism, and two new characters: Escoffier, a five-star Cryo Polearm user, and Ifa, a four-star Anemo Catalyst user.

It follows Version 5.5 and precedes 5.7. The Archon Quest takes place in Mondstadt during the Windblume Festival and deals with a murder trial against Albedo, which turns out to be a trap for a monster that imitates other people.

Escoffier's Story Quest, Dulciaria Structura Chapter Act I (Treasured Above All), opened at the same time and sends the Traveler to Hotel Debord in Fontaine. The wiki notes that "Paralogism" is the shortest version title.

Paralogism is the final act of the Interlude Chapter as of the cutoff. Interlude acts are stand-alone follow-ups to earlier quests rather than parts of the main Archon Quest chain.

Release: Released 2025-05-07, between 5.5 and 5.7.

Phase I banners were La Chanson Cerise (Escoffier and Ifa) and In the Name of the Rosula (Navia and Ifa). Phase II, from 2025-05-27, reran Kinich, the Raiden Shogun and a Chronicled Wish.

New weapons were Symphonist of Scents (five-star Polearm) and Sequence of Solitude (four-star Bow). New events included Whirling Waltz, Operation Downpour Simulation, Legends Ablaze: Cross-Border Brawl and Chronicle of Shifting Stratagems. The first Imaginarium Theater season opened on 2025-06-01 with Electro, Cryo and Dendro required.

New enemies were the Secret Source Automaton: Overseer Device and the chess-themed trial The Game Before the Gate, with matching Ascended Sample materials (Knight, Rook and Queen). Genius Invokation TCG gained Sethos and Xilonen cards.

Characters: Escoffier ("Tasteful Excellence") is a five-star Cryo Polearm character; the wiki describes her as a renowned Fontainian chef, formerly of Hotel Debord, with exacting standards. Ifa ("In the Wake of Wandering Winds") is a four-star Anemo Catalyst character. Their own files cover their profiles.

New dishes of the version included Gateau Debord: Magnifique and Emotional Support, and the namecards were Escoffier: Charm, Ifa: Bro and Travel Notes: Balletica.

Archon quest: Paralogism (Interlude Chapter Act IV) needs Adventure Rank 40 and the earlier acts Inversion of Genesis and Traveler Observation Report. During 5.6 up to before 6.0 a Quick Start let players enter it at Adventure Rank 28 after A New Star Approaches. It has three quests: Crimes One and Two, The Hunger of Many and The Gardener.

During the Windblume Festival, people in Mondstadt act oddly and Albedo is tried for murder and illegal disposal of human remains. The Knights and Church of Favonius had staged the trial months ahead to flush out an imitator. Albedo explains that the imitator is a spawn of the dragon Durin, which can copy others. The imposter Hertha flees and monsters attack the city.

Albedo reveals he had been stationed in Dragonspine to watch Durin, whose remains were stirring, and that he had killed and buried people who were really monsters wearing human identities. He and the Traveler get reagents from the Hexenzirkel after a chess trial involving Barbeloth, then extract energy from Durin's Core. At the festival, with Venti singing as Windblume Star, Albedo's alchemy turns Mini Durin human, taking the fallen Durin's place. Albedo also mentions that Rhinedottir had devoured Naberius, the Ruler of Life.

166.content:
Paralogism is the fourth act of the Interlude Chapter, set at Mondstadt's Windblume Festival. It centres on Albedo's trial, a trap for a shapeshifting spawn of Durin, and ends with Mini Durin becoming human. Characters include Albedo, Venti, Jean, Eula, Kaeya, Diluc, Rosaria, the Hexenzirkel's Alice and Barbeloth.

Dahlia, a deacon of the Church, is revealed to also be Barbatos's herald. Phonia, missing for over half a year, is taken into custody, and Albedo promises to save her.

key: Version 5.7: A Space and Time for You
167.comment: Version 5.7: A Space and Time for You
167.content:
Version 5.7: A Space and Time for You (also: Version 5.7, Genshin Impact 5.7): Version 5.7, "A Space and Time for You", was released on 2025-06-18. It added no new area. Its main content was Chapter V Act VI of the Archon Quest, set in Natlan, and two characters: Skirk (five-star Cryo Sword) and Dahlia (four-star Hydro Sword).

It follows Version 5.6 and precedes 5.8. Act VI returns to the thread of the Traveler's search for their sibling, who is revealed to lead the Abyss Order's activities in Natlan.

Skirk's Story Quest, Crystallina Chapter, began with Act I, Whispers Betwixt Stars and Night. A limited-time combat event, Stygian Onslaught: Incursion Repeller, also opened.

Phase II reran Mavuika and Emilie.

Release: Released 2025-06-18, between 5.6 and 5.8.

Phase I banners were Void Star's Advent (Skirk and Dahlia) and The Transcendent One Returns (Shenhe and Dahlia). Phase II banners were Ancient Flame Ablaze (Mavuika) and Ambrosial Essence (Emilie).

The new five-star weapon was Azurelight (Sword). Five existing weapons gained new appearances (Serpent Devourer, Ardent Storm, Shattered Moon, Hallowed Fetters and Starpiercer) with matching Sublimation versions. Artifact Reshape, using Dust of Enlightenment, was added.

Spiral Abyss refreshed on 2025-07-16. On mobile, players now choose between Full Resources and Basic Resources downloads at first launch, and the latter leaves out some optional Archon, Story and Hangout quests. Genius Invokation TCG gained cards for Chasca, Citlali and Mavuika.

Characters: Skirk ("Void Star") is a five-star Cryo Sword character. Dahlia ("Ode and Oblation") is a four-star Hydro Sword character. Their own files carry the profiles.

The namecards were Skirk: Lone Shadow and Dahlia: Sacred Duty, with Travel Notes: Speculation.

Archon quest: Chapter V Act VI, A Space and Time for You, has three quests: The Key That Unlocks Fate, "Savior" and A Space and Time Without You. It needs Adventure Rank 40.

The Traveler finds the key to the Hibernation Chamber on the spaceship that brought the twins to Teyvat, which they know belongs to their sibling. The Abyss Order attacks every tribe at once. The Traveler befriends a woman called Direidyth, who is seeking a Savior; the Traveler can see the monsters that attack her only while holding her hand. Dainsleif arrives and joins the Traveler in assaulting the Order's base at Ochkanatlan.

At the base, an Iniquitous Baptist claims the Order's wishes have been fulfilled. Dainsleif recognises the Baptist as his former master Haden, and learns that Haden's talk of reviving Khaenri'ah was a bluff meant to extract his memories. The Traveler's sibling then appears to explain that the attack was a feint so he could speak with the Lord of the Night, and that he had woven Khaenri'ah's Ley Lines over Natlan to create an Atlas of the New World. He hopes to meet the Traveler again in the new world.

168.comment: Version 5.7: A Space and Time for You: Direidyth
168.content: A woman from a faraway village, sent by her grandmother to find a Savior who could stop a prophesied doomsday. The Traveler can see the monsters stalking her only while holding her hand. She and the Traveler later learn they are from different points in time.

169.comment: Version 5.7: A Space and Time for You: Iniquitous Baptist
169.content: An Abyss Order leader met at the Order's stronghold in Ochkanatlan, after the Order attacked every Natlan tribe at once, which Iansan calls its first coordinated attack there. Dainsleif identifies him as Haden, his former master.

170.content:
Version 5.8: Sunspray Summer Resort (also: Version 5.8, Genshin Impact 5.8): Version 5.8, "Sunspray Summer Resort", was released on 2025-07-30. It added the Easybreeze Holiday Resort, a summer-themed area, the prelude act of the Song of the Welkin Moon Archon Quest, The Journey Home, the Lunar-Charged elemental reaction and one new character, the five-star Electro Polearm user Ineffa.

It follows Version 5.7 and was the last version before 6.0, which moves the story to Nod-Krai. The Journey Home is set in Natlan, bridges Chapter V and the next chapter, and brings in visitors from Nod-Krai.

Easybreeze Holiday Resort, also known as Tenochtzitoc, is a sparsely inhabited island off Natlan's westernmost edge, and is the first summer-themed map to become permanent. The Sunspray Summer Resort Story Quest, with four parts, is set there.

The wiki marks the Sunspray Summer Resort quest as a stub, so its plot is not recorded here.

Release: Released 2025-07-30, between 5.7 and 6.0.

Phase I banners were Astral Actuation (Ineffa) and a rerun of Starry Night's Whispers (Citlali). Phase II banners were Sharktacular Surfari (Mualani) and Piercing Shot's Crimson Wake (Chasca).

New weapons were Fractured Halo (five-star Polearm) and Flame-Forged Insight (four-star Claymore). Outfits were Adventures in Blazing Hue (Bennett) and Tranquil Banquet (Yelan). Events included Sunspray Summer Resort, Tracing Vanishing Trails, Mementos of Teyvat: Prelude of the Frozen Veil and An Easy-Breezy Natlan in an Easy-Breezy Summer!

Spiral Abyss refreshed on 2025-08-16. The system additions included the Asha Saurian companion, the Natlan: Plains of Flowing Flames music album and the Leaping Spirit Piano. Hidden exploration objectives at the resort included Ayar Heroes' Cup and Easybreeze Speed Champions Tournament.

Characters: Ineffa ("Boom Boom Thunderwave") is a five-star Electro Polearm character. Her own file carries the profile.

Her namecard is Ineffa: Command.

Lunar charged: Lunar-Charged is a new elemental reaction added in 5.8 and is labelled as game mechanics: when Electro meets Hydro and certain other conditions are met, a thundercloud forms and repeatedly strikes nearby targets affected by both elements for Electro damage.

The damage can critically hit, and it is based on every character who applied an element during the reaction. See the system entry for details.

Archon quest: The Journey Home is the prelude act of Song of the Welkin Moon and has three quests: Flamelets, Smoldering and Searing. It needs Adventure Rank 40, with a Quick Start from Adventure Rank 28 after A New Star Approaches, and is followed by A Dance of Snowy Tides and Hoarfrost Groves in 6.0.

The Traveler, Paimon, Chasca and Ifa find an unconscious automaton washed ashore, who calls for the Traveler and Paimon; merchants from Nod-Krai name her Ineffa. She has lost her memories and carries a sealed cryptex. Merchants from Nod-Krai say they fled the Fatui's actions there and the tension between religious groups, and the Traveler's group helps them. The Fatui then manipulate Secret Source automatons to attack and seek a hidden facility.

The facility is the Temple of Cascading Colors. There an automaton that is the Eighth Lord of the Thirteen Sovereign Lords tells Ineffa that she split into two selves after the war, one that sought a new home and became Ineffa and one hostile to humanity, the Eleventh Lord. The hostile self lures Ineffa to the core and tries to reclaim it. Ineffa crushes that core, then builds a new one and gains an Electro Moon Wheel, and the Eleventh Lord is destroyed. The cryptex holds a letter from Varka telling the Traveler to prepare for Nod-Krai and to meet him at a tavern called The Flagship. Ineffa plans to stay in Natlan for now.

171.comment: Version 5.8: Sunspray Summer Resort: Easybreeze Holiday Resort
171.content: A sparsely inhabited island off the westernmost edge of Natlan, which the wiki says is where the long war had begun and met its end. Its name Tenochtzitoc translates as a cavern of stone and prickly pears, though prickly pears no longer grow there. It is the setting of the Sunspray Summer Resort Story Quest.

172.comment: Version 5.8: Sunspray Summer Resort: Leaping Spirit Piano
172.content: A new instrument for the Repertoire of Myriad Melodies added in 5.8, purchasable from Djembe Studios.

key: Version 6.0: A Dance of Snowy Tides and Hoarfrost Groves
Song of the Welkin Moon: Segue
173.comment: Version 6.0: A Dance of Snowy Tides and Hoarfrost Groves
173.content:
Version 6.0: A Dance of Snowy Tides and Hoarfrost Groves (also: Version 6.0, Genshin Impact 6.0, Version Luna I, Luna I, Song of the Welkin Moon: Segue): Version 6.0, officially "Luna I" (Song of the Welkin Moon: Segue), was released on 2025-09-10. It opened the new region Nod-Krai and added Archon Quest Acts I-II, with the new characters Lauma, Flins and Aino.

It follows Version 5.8 and precedes Luna II (6.1). The wiki notes it is the first version not officially referred to by its number, being the first update of the "Luna" cycle.

The Archon Quest takes the Traveler, Paimon and the automaton Ineffa from Natlan to Nod-Krai, where moon-power called kuuvahki, the Frostmoon Scions, the Lightkeepers and a new Fatui presence meet. New systems include Moonsign, the Lunar-Bloom reaction, the Luna Treasure Compass, the Silvermoon Hall: Selenic Chronicles reputation line, Travelers' Tales and the Repertoire of Myriad Melodies' first album.

Spiral Abyss blessings already refer to Lunar-Bloom and Lunar-Charged damage. The version title and the Act I title are the same, "A Dance of Snowy Tides and Hoarfrost Groves"; Act II is "Elegy of Dust and Lamplight". Together the two acts end with the Moon Goddess Columbina saying she wants to return to the moon, and with Varka introducing himself to the villain Rerir.

Release: Released 2025-09-10, after 5.8 and before Luna II (6.1).

Phase I banners: Moonsong of the Groves (Lauma), The Moongrass' Enlightenment (Nahida), Roving Chalice of Dewgrass (Chronicled Wish). Phase II, from 2025-09-30: The Lone Light Knocks at Night (Flins and Aino) and Discerner of Enigmas (Yelan and Aino).

New weapons were Nightweaver's Looking Glass (5-star Catalyst) and Bloodsoaked Ruins (5-star Polearm) from the event wish; Serenity's Call, Master Key, Prospector's Shovel, Blackmarrow Lantern and Snare Hook as forgeable 4-star weapons; the event weapon Etherlight Spindlelute; and the quest weapon Moonweaver's Dawn. New artifacts were Silken Moon's Serenade and Night of the Sky's Unveiling.

Events included Clink Clank Clash, Lightgleaner's Journey, Dodoco's Blow-Up-Erative Bomb-Nanza, Overflowing Favor, Rainbow's End: Silvery Flux and Uncover Lunar Realms, Hone the Eventide Radiance. The Spiral Abyss updated on 2025-09-16 and 2025-10-16. A new Imaginarium Theater season, with a Lunar Mode and Lunar Arcana, began on 2025-10-01. Quality-of-life changes included more inventory space, a revised Condensed Resin recipe, a Preset Teams feature for Spiral Abyss and Stygian Onslaught, and Adventure EXP for Oculi and chests.

Region: New region: Nod-Krai, with Lempo Isle, Hiisi Island and Paha Isle. In the story it is a northern archipelago rich in kuuvahki, the pure energy of the moon, where Fatui forces have recently arrived.

Nasha Town, the port, has the Adventurers' Guild branch, the tavern The Flagship, the Curatorium of Secrets run by Nefer, and Aino's workshop. Hiisi Island holds the Frostmoon Enclave, and Silvermoon Hall, where Columbina stays, lies nearby. The Wild Hunt is fought in the graveyards to the north, and the showdown with Rerir takes place at Starsand Shoal.

New monsters include the Frostnight Scions, Radiant Beasts, Wilderness Ghouls, Fatui Oprichniki and a family of Landcruisers. New wildlife includes the Frostfin Whale, Rimehorn Deer and Moonglow Firefly; new materials include Moonfall Silver and Frostlamp Flower.

Characters: Lauma ("Evermoon's Sacrament Song") is a 5-star Dendro Catalyst, Flins ("Shadowy Lights, Stranger Wights") a 5-star Electro Polearm, Aino ("Clinky-Clank Gadgets-A-Gogo") a 4-star Hydro Claymore.

In the story Lauma is a Moonchanter of the Frostmoon Scions, Flins a Ratnik who patrols the northern graveyards against the Wild Hunt, and Aino Nod-Krai's young inventor, looked after by Ineffa. Story figures introduced include Nefer, boss of the Curatorium of Secrets, her employee Jahoda, the Moon Goddess Columbina and the villain Rerir.

The World Quest Lightkeepers' Oath needs a Lightkeeper such as Flins or Illuga as active character, and The Lost Child's Tale needs Flins. Columbina is not playable in this version; she appears through the Silvermoon Hall: Selenic Chronicles reputation quests.

Archon quest: Song of the Welkin Moon Act I, "A Dance of Snowy Tides and Hoarfrost Groves", and Act II, "Elegy of Dust and Lamplight".

Act I (Where the Moon Rises, Reunion Beneath the Moonlight, In the Shadows of Night) needs Adventure Rank 40 and the Interlude Chapter act Paralogism; a Quick Start allows entry at Adventure Rank 28 after A New Star Approaches. The Traveler arrives in Nasha Town and recognises the moon-power as the same they felt after landing on Teyvat. Searching for their spaceship, they meet Flins, Lauma, Aino, Jahoda and Nefer, are warned off by the Harbinger Marionette, and meet a young woman called both Columbina and Kuutar. Lauma explains the Three Moons and the "Moon Marrow". After a sanctum is entered and the Marrow stolen, Lauma tells the Frostmoon Scions the sky is false. Act II (five quests, from Fulminations and Undercurrents to Rest Beyond Reach) reveals the Wild Hunt as Rerir's work.

In Act I the Traveler and the sibling enter a hidden sanctum under the statue of Kuutar; the Marrow is later taken by Marionette to Starsand Shoal and won back after a Wild Hunt attack, and the Traveler stores it in their own body. Lauma cuts her hand to mix her silver blood into medicine for a sick child and asks the Traveler to keep it secret. In Act II, Rerir passes as the Ratnik Sousi, who is found dead, and Flins is accused. Rerir tricks the town into charging Aino's Boom and Blast Kuuvahki Cannon to regain part of a body. Flins's lantern holds a fragment of Rerir's heart. When Sandrone's robot Pulonia fails to stop him, Columbina teleports the group to Silvermoon Hall, then realises her strength is not returning. Columbina says she wants to return to the moon, where she would find her answers and "home". Rerir is one of the Five Sinners of Khaenri'ah, called the "Rächer of Solnari", who fell into the moon's reflection.

key: A Dance of Snowy Tides and Hoarfrost Groves
174.comment: Version 6.0: A Dance of Snowy Tides and Hoarfrost Groves: A Dance of Snowy Tides and Hoarfrost Groves
174.content:
Act I of Song of the Welkin Moon and the title of Version 6.0. The Traveler, Paimon and Ineffa leave Natlan by boat for Nasha Town in Nod-Krai. The Traveler recognises the moon-power as the same they felt after landing on Teyvat and searches for their spaceship. They meet the Ratnik Flins, the Moonchanter Lauma, the inventor Aino, the Curatorium's Nefer and her employee Jahoda, are warned by the Harbinger Marionette, and meet Columbina. The act ends with the Moon Marrow stored inside the Traveler and Lauma telling her people that the sky is false.

The sibling appears twice: once leading the Traveler into the sanctum, and once as an illusion in the fog produced by the Wild Hunt. The Traveler sees through the illusion because it contradicts what their sibling had said about finding them in hypersleep.

175.comment: Version 6.0: A Dance of Snowy Tides and Hoarfrost Groves: Elegy of Dust and Lamplight
175.content:
Act II of Song of the Welkin Moon. The Wild Hunt grows bolder, and Rerir, who is behind it, manipulates Aino's cannon to restore part of his body. The Traveler and Flins, who is accused of killing Sousi, stop the shot only in part; Columbina saves the group from Rerir.

Columbina uses the Moon Marrow to show the Traveler a memory of the crash in which the sibling stands outside the ship, although the Traveler knows they never left it. She teaches the Traveler to hide the Marrow they carry, and says two moons cannot rise at once and that a Frost Moon Marrow cannot exist unless that moon is destroyed.

176.comment: Version 6.0: A Dance of Snowy Tides and Hoarfrost Groves: Moon Marrow
176.content:
The Frostmoon Scions' relic in Version 6.0 is the Moon Marrow, used in a ritual held when the moon is closest to Teyvat. Columbina says this one is a piece of the remains of a moon goddess, Aria. It was stolen from the sanctum, held by Marionette, and recovered by the Traveler.

Kuuvahki and abyssal energy are polar opposites, and whichever side wins absorbs the other's energy, which is how Rerir's plan is worked out in Act II. Lauma describes carrying a Marrow in one's body as a grueling trial of will; an earlier Moonchanter did it but lasted only two days.

key: Version 6.1: An Elegy for Faded Moonlight
Song of the Welkin Moon: Reprise
177.comment: Version 6.1: An Elegy for Faded Moonlight
177.content:
Version 6.1: An Elegy for Faded Moonlight (also: Version 6.1, Genshin Impact 6.1, Version Luna II, Luna II, Song of the Welkin Moon: Reprise): Version 6.1, officially "Luna II" (Song of the Welkin Moon: Reprise), was released on 2025-10-22 as "An Elegy for Faded Moonlight". It added no new area. Its main content was Archon Quest Acts III and IV, the 5-star Dendro Catalyst Nefer and the open beta of Miliastra Wonderland.

It follows Version 6.0 (Luna I) and precedes Luna III (6.2). In the Archon Quest, the Traveler and the people of Nod-Krai finish the fight against the Wild Hunt's mastermind, Rerir.

The wiki also lists the Wonderland Manekin, a 5-star Sword character tied to Miliastra Wonderland. Act III is "A Nation That Doesn't Exist" and Act IV, which gives the version its title, is "An Elegy for Faded Moonlight". Act IV ends with Rerir expelled from Teyvat through a moon gate.

Act IV makes Nefer's past a stage of the plot, with a ritual that opens into her memories of the Sumeru desert. The version also re-runs Furina, Arlecchino and Zhongli in its banners.

Release: Released 2025-10-22, after Luna I (6.0) and before Luna III (6.2).

Phase I banners: Temptation of the Crimson Sands (Nefer) and Chanson of Many Waters (Furina). Phase II: The Hearth's Ashen Shadow (Arlecchino) and Gentry of Hermitage (Zhongli).

New weapons were Reliquary of Truth (5-star Catalyst), Sacrificer's Staff (4-star Polearm) and Dawning Frost (4-star Catalyst). New events included Ruins Exploration: Fieldwise Center, Dance Dance Dynamic Disco, Saurian Sojourn and Overflowing Abundance. Imaginarium Theater seasons began on 2025-11-01 and 2025-12-01; the Spiral Abyss updated on 2025-11-16.

The Archon Quest was joined by a set of Nefer World Quests (A Small Venture, Research Spillover, The Disturbance Caused by Theft, The Haunted Pirate Shipwreck, The Suspicious Hermit, The Vanishing Bounty Target, The Dust Settles and The Man Who Once Lied) that need Nefer in the account, plus The Spurious Cannot Be Made Genuine. The new monster is Frostnight Herra, dropping Radiant Antler. New recipes included Lohikeitto and Lakkaberry Pie, new namecards Nefer: Secrets, Travel Notes: Bygone Ruins and Nod-Krai: Moonlight, and the Genius Invokation TCG gained Varesa, Ifa and Hydro Tulpa.

Characters: Nefer ("Secret Beneath the Sands") is a 5-star Dendro Catalyst. The Wonderland Manekin is a 5-star Sword character for Miliastra Wonderland.

In the story, Nefer is the boss of Nasha Town's Curatorium of Secrets and, as Act IV shows, grew up in the Sumeru desert. Her own file carries the detail.

Miliastra wonderland: Miliastra Wonderland entered open beta in this version, with creator-made stages, social features and customisation content.

The related new systems are the Miliastra Pass, Ode, Explore Wonderlands, the event Invitation to Wonderland: A Curious Awakening, the Wonderland Level and the Lobby.

Archon quest: Song of the Welkin Moon Act III, "A Nation That Doesn't Exist", and Act IV, "An Elegy for Faded Moonlight". Both need Adventure Rank 40.

Act III (Hidden in the Shadows, Special Operation, Everlasting As the Moon): Rerir, now with a body, attacks Columbina after the Wild Hunt drains the quarry's kuuvahki. Varka and the group make a secret base, Nefer is persuaded to help, Sandrone allows Columbina to use her bureau, and Arlecchino, who is a descendant of the Crimson Moon Dynasty, opens a way to the Iridescent Marrow. Act IV (All Is Foretold, Dance of Death: Serpent and Scorpion, Echoes of Fate): the group learns Rerir's past with Dainsleif's help, he is trapped in Nefer's chessbox and finally expelled from Teyvat.

Act III: Columbina and the Traveler are cornered by the Wild Hunt at Thunderclap Reef until Arlecchino burns it away. Arlecchino's hands are corrupted by the Abyss when she forces open the way out of the Iridescent Marrow's domain; she refuses the Traveler's offer to purify it. She tells Columbina to change her name after Rerir is sorted out. Nefer's ritual shows that Rerir was a Khaenri'ahn under King Irmin, engaged to Tholindis, and ordered to kill descendants of the Crimson Moon Dynasty. Act IV: Albedo, with Durin (Mini Durin from Simulanka), and Dainsleif join; ritual memories show Rerir ordered to eliminate his own fiancee, helping Dainsleif free Vedrfolnir, then finding Tholindis falling into a portal, accepting a voice's offer of power. Rerir intrudes on Nefer's own memory-domain, and the group fights him; Albedo and Durin siphon his power into Columbina, who opens a moon gate that Dainsleif holds from behind. Nefer is blinded temporarily. The act closes with Sandrone, Columbina and the Traveler at the bureau, and with Sandrone mentioning the Lord-Artificer, whom the Traveler recognises as Alain Guillotin.

178.comment: Version 6.1: An Elegy for Faded Moonlight: A Nation That Doesn't Exist
178.content:
Act III of Song of the Welkin Moon. The Wild Hunt drains the kuuvahki from places such as the quarry, and Rerir attacks Columbina. Varka rescues the group and brings the Curatorium's Nefer into the plan. Columbina goes with the Traveler to the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau, where Sandrone agrees to help, then to Arlecchino, who agrees to find the Iridescent Marrow.

Nefer's ritual with Jahoda and Lauma shows Rerir's identity as a Khaenri'ahn under Irmin, and a memory of Tholindis that is oddly in his possession. Columbina and the Traveler recover the Iridescent Marrow from a domain guarded by riftwolves, and Columbina gains it.

key: Dance of Death: Serpent and Scorpion
179.comment: Version 6.1: An Elegy for Faded Moonlight: An Elegy for Faded Moonlight
179.content:
Act IV of Song of the Welkin Moon and the title of Version 6.1. Dainsleif explains how the Five Sinners of Khaenri'ah came to be; Nefer's ritual shows Rerir's past and then pulls the group into her own memories. Rerir is sealed in Nefer's chessbox, breaks out, and is thrown out of Teyvat through a moon gate.

Rerir's past, as shown in the ritual: he was told to kill Tholindis, helped Dainsleif free his brother Vedrfolnir, and then found Tholindis stepping into a portal so that he could live. Nefer's memory-domain shows her adopted family in the Shimti tribe, their destruction by the Iab tribe, her time at the Sumeru Akademiya and a temple of Thoth, one of the Seven Pillars of King Deshret.

key: Version 6.2: A Nocturne of the Far North
Song of the Welkin Moon: Interlude
180.comment: Version 6.2: A Nocturne of the Far North
180.content:
Version 6.2: A Nocturne of the Far North (also: Version 6.2, Genshin Impact 6.2, Version Luna III, Luna III, Song of the Welkin Moon: Interlude): Version 6.2, officially "Luna III" (Song of the Welkin Moon: Interlude), was released on 2025-12-03 as "A Nocturne of the Far North". It added no new area. Its main content was Archon Quest Acts V and VI, the Story Quest Draco Rubedo Chapter, and the characters Durin (5-star Pyro Sword) and Jahoda (4-star Anemo Bow).

It follows Luna II (6.1) and precedes Luna IV (6.3). The Archon Quest centres on Moon-Prayer Night, the festival on which the fading Moon Goddess Columbina planned to return to the moon.

Act V is "A Nocturne of the Far North" and Act VI is "Melting Moonlight in the Morning Mist". The acts cover the search for Columbina's true name, her return as Columbina Hyposelenia, the festival, and an ambush by the Fatui Harbinger Dottore that leaves Columbina trapped beyond reach.

The acts also reveal the history of the Three Moons as told by murals in Hyperborean ruins, and let the Traveler's friends from Mondstadt, the Hexenzirkel, the Curatorium and the Frostmoon Scions commit to opposing Dottore.

Release: Released 2025-12-03, after Luna II (6.1) and before Luna IV (6.3).

Phase I banners: Rubedo, of White Stone Born (Durin and Jahoda) and Ballad in Goblets (Venti and Jahoda). Phase II: Cornucopia of Contention (Varesa) and Forgefire's Blessing (Xilonen).

New weapons were Athame Artis (5-star Sword), The Daybreak Chronicles (5-star Bow) and Rainbow Serpent's Rain Bow (4-star Bow). New events were Soulblazers' Snowbound Journey, Bing-Bang Finchball, Heroic Clash: Saurian Brawl and Marvelous Merchandise. The Spiral Abyss updated on 2025-12-16 and a new Imaginarium Theater season began on 2026-01-01.

New systems included a Component Sharing Platform for Miliastra Wonderland (with Frosty Court and the event Invitation to Wonderland: In Search of Inspiration), the Witch's Homework event with the Hexerei: Secret Rite for eight Mondstadt characters (Sucrose, Mona, Durin, Klee, Albedo, Venti, Fischl and Razor), and Repertoire of Myriad Melodies additions: Specializations and a Co-op Ensemble. New enemies and drops included the Super-Heavy Landrover: Mechanized Fortress, Cyclic Military Kuuvahki Core and the Pale-Furred Wolf, and the new material Refined Heart.

Characters: Durin ("The Undying Fire") is a 5-star Pyro Sword character; Jahoda ("Windthreading Shadow") is a 4-star Anemo Bow character.

Durin was already a story figure: the wiki's Act IV summary identifies him as Mini Durin from Simulanka, appearing alongside Albedo. Jahoda is the Curatorium of Secrets employee introduced in Version 6.0. Their own files carry the detail. Durin's Story Quest is Draco Rubedo Chapter Act I, "The Magic Known as Storytelling".

Archon quest: Song of the Welkin Moon Act V, "A Nocturne of the Far North", and Act VI, "Melting Moonlight in the Morning Mist". Both need Adventure Rank 40.

Act V (In the Shifting Light of the Moon, Ripples That Will Never Reach): about two months after arriving, the Traveler prepares for Moon-Prayer Night. Columbina plans to return to the moon, phantoms of the past appear across Nod-Krai, and Columbina begins to fade because she lacks a name or a role the world accepts. Alice and Nicole of the Hexenzirkel explain what must be done. Act VI (Where Does Her Name Rest?, The Night the Moon Returns Home, Return to the Moon, The Empty Courtyard): the group finds that she needs only a name she chooses, enjoys a final Moon-Prayer Night, and loses her when Dottore attacks.

In Act V, Durin's group studies visions of Nod-Krai during the Khaenri'ah Cataclysm, which Flins calls fixed history, and Nicole selects the Traveler, Lauma and Arlecchino as the three people able to enter the Hyperborean ruins after three days of kuuvahki infusion. In Act VI murals show the Three Moons created by Nibelung, used in his war with the Heavenly Principles and then shattered or cast away; one moon survived, which allowed Columbina to be born. At the platform Hyperboreans used to contact the moons, Nicole concludes Columbina never had a true name, and the Traveler calls her "Columbina". Back in Silvermoon Hall her full name appears: Columbina Hyposelenia. The townspeople greet her, "Welcome home, Moon Goddess." On the night she hangs a wish, receives a handmade greeting card, and plans hidden moonlight messages for her friends. At the ritual Dottore appears, uses a false moon and the power of all three moons to freeze time, and Columbina leaps into a moon gate of her own, vanishing into the same realm where Rerir fled. Arlecchino says that she will act as Peruere against Dottore if the Tsaritsa will not judge in time, and Varka rallies the allies. The optional quest The Empty Courtyard shows the Luonnotar and the kuuhenki waiting at Silvermoon Hall, and a brief meeting with Sandrone.

key: A Nocturne of the Far North
In the Shifting Light of the Moon
181.comment: Version 6.2: A Nocturne of the Far North: A Nocturne of the Far North
181.content:
Act V of Song of the Welkin Moon and the title of Version 6.2. About two months after the Traveler's arrival, Nod-Krai prepares for Moon-Prayer Night. Columbina tells the Traveler she will return to the moon on that night; if she stays in Teyvat she will cease to exist. Phantoms and mirages of Nod-Krai's past appear. Columbina then disappears from Silvermoon Hall and fades, and Alice appears to tell the Traveler the border of Teyvat is destabilising and to name two tasks: find Columbina's true name and send her to the real moon.

Durin's side of the investigation shows Cataclysm-era Nod-Krai; Durin struggles with his abyssal nature and concludes that his darkness can also be strength. Nicole, called Mage N, explains how Hyperboreans tried to reach the moons and says that the moon goddesses were erased from the world's natural order. Durin, Albedo and the Wanderer partly change the fate of a phantom and, for the first time, one remembers them.

key: Melting Moonlight in the Morning Mist
The Night the Moon Returns Home
182.comment: Version 6.2: A Nocturne of the Far North: Melting Moonlight in the Morning Mist
182.content:
Act VI of Song of the Welkin Moon. In the Hyperborean ruins the group learns the history of the Three Moons and that Columbina has no true name from the past; she is restored by being called Columbina. After a night of festival, Dottore ambushes her at the ritual, and she vanishes into a moon gate. The story ends with the allies pledging to find her.

Dottore, the wiki says, had distorted the causal structure of the Hyperborean phantoms to extract forbidden lunar knowledge and craft a false moon. Columbina's last words to the Traveler are that her name, once a codename, became real because of her friends, and that moonlight will always connect them.

key: Version 6.3: A Traveler on a Winter's Night
Song of the Welkin Moon: Postlude
183.comment: Version 6.3: A Traveler on a Winter's Night
183.content:
Version 6.3: A Traveler on a Winter's Night (also: Version 6.3, Genshin Impact 6.3, Version Luna IV, Luna IV, Song of the Welkin Moon: Postlude): Version 6.3, officially "Luna IV" (Song of the Welkin Moon: Postlude), was released on 2026-01-14 as "A Traveler on a Winter's Night". It added the Nod-Krai area The Lament of the Cliff-Shadowed Hollow, Archon Quest Acts VII and VIII, and the characters Columbina, Zibai and Illuga.

It follows Luna III (6.2) and precedes Luna V (6.4). The Archon Quest follows the fight against the Fatui Harbinger Dottore, who has trapped Columbina and then the Traveler, and ends with the Moon Goddess's return.

Act VII is "A Traveler on a Winter's Night" and Act VIII, "True Moon", carries the story's climax. The version also adds the Lunar-Crystallize reaction, a Meeting Point system, Dottore as a new weekly boss and the Story Quest "A Lanternlit Ode to the Silver Moon".

Its Song of the Welkin Moon subtitles run Segue (6.0), Reprise (6.1), Interlude (6.2) and Postlude (6.3). In the story the Frost Moon is brought down into Teyvat and remains there after the battle.

Release: Released 2026-01-14, after Luna III (6.2) and before Luna V (6.4).

Phase I banners: Somnias a Luna (Columbina) and Astral Actuation (Ineffa). Phase II, from 2026-02-03: Harmonious Abundance (Zibai and Illuga) and Decree of the Deeps (Neuvillette and Illuga).

New weapons were Nocturne's Curtain Call (5-star Catalyst) and Lightbearing Moonshard (5-star Sword). New artifacts were Aubade of Morningstar and Moon and A Day Carved From Rising Winds. New outfits were As Heaven and Earth Are Made Anew (Traveler), Rainlit Bamboo Reverie (Yaoyao) and Melusent Gift (Neuvillette). Events included A Lanternlit Ode to the Silver Moon, Moonlit Patrol Exercise, Shutterflash Memory Hunt, May Fortune Find You: Springs Premonition, Ley Line Overflow and New Year's Gift.

New enemies include The Doctor, Lord of the Hidden Depths: Whisperer of Nightmares, Fishers of Hidden Depths, three Frostnight Scions (Surging Currents, Veiled Cloudchaser and Gilded Sunshard) and the Radiant Glacial Wolf. The Doctor drops Mask of the Virtuous Doctor, Madman's Restraint and Elixir of the Heretic. New domains are Moonchild's Treasures and False Moon Institute. A new Imaginarium Theater season began on 2026-02-01 and the second Spiral Abyss phase of the version updated on 2026-02-16. The Genius Invokation TCG gained Ororon and Skirk cards.

Region: New area: Nod-Krai: The Lament of the Cliff-Shadowed Hollow, with Voidsea Outlook, Wavechaser Plain and Ashveil Peak.

The version also adds a Meeting Point system with three locations, the Witch's Garden, Favonius Keep and Cliffwatch Camp. New wildlife includes the Cinderneck Stork, Crowned Eagle and Thornback Gecko, and new materials are Pine Amber and Winter Icelea.

Characters: Columbina ("Welkin Moon's Homecoming") is a 5-star Hydro Catalyst, Zibai ("White Horse's Fleeting Spring") a 5-star Geo Sword, and Illuga ("Nightmare's Burning Heart") a 4-star Geo Polearm.

Columbina is the Moon Goddess at the centre of the Archon Quest and is playable from this version. Illuga appears as a younger friend of Flins and, at the end of Act VIII, is encouraged to become the Lightkeepers' representative in the new League. Their own files carry the detail.

Archon quest: Song of the Welkin Moon Act VII, "A Traveler on a Winter's Night", and Act VIII, "True Moon". Both need Adventure Rank 40.

Act VII (Moonless Night, Where Our Space and Time Intersect, Tracing the Footsteps of the Past): Dottore, the Fatui Harbinger, has made an artificial Moon Marrow and a false moon. He captures the Traveler and offers them an alliance. Meanwhile Columbina, trapped in the moon's reflection, travels back in time to leave clues. Nod-Krai is partly evacuated and the Wanderer, Albedo and Durin study the energy fields. Act VIII (The First Sliver of Moonlight, Descending Moon, Welkin Moon's Homecoming): the Traveler is rescued, Columbina meets the three moon goddesses, and the final battle destroys Dottore's false-moon form but costs Sandrone her life.

Act VII: the group is "cursed" by Dottore, so that leaving Nod-Krai would activate it. Dottore admits having knocked the Traveler out for over a month, mocks their relationship to Teyvat and offers to restore their rightful Descender status. Travelling back in time, Columbina creates the Luonnotar from a part of her soul to follow the Traveler and guide them to her. Act VIII: Rerir, now calm after rejecting the abyssal energy in the moon's reflection, asks Columbina to carry a message to Tholindis. The three Moon Sisters, Sonnet, Canon and Aria, help Columbina by lending her their authorities; she disperses into moonlight so that her spirit can return. Sandrone's world-formula needs the Wanderer's Irminsul core. At the battle Sandrone shields the Traveler from a killing blow and is killed; her real formula had been hidden in Pulonia. The Frost Moon is pulled into Teyvat, the Trilune Goddess opens her eyes and the combined fighters break Dottore's artificial Marrow. Afterward the Frost Moon stays in Teyvat, a new League of Nod-Krai's factions is formed, and the Tsaritsa revokes the Palestar Edict, Columbina's arrest warrant.

184.comment: Version 6.3: A Traveler on a Winter's Night: A Traveler on a Winter's Night
184.content:
Act VII of Song of the Welkin Moon and the title of Version 6.3. A few days after the Dottore incident, the Traveler and friends go to Dottore's lab, where Sandrone and Arlecchino had gone first. Dottore, armed with an artificial Moon Marrow that heals his wounds, captures the Traveler and sends the rest away. Dottore's false moon replaces the Frost Moon, energy fields appear across the islands, and everyone who entered his lab is cursed. Columbina, alive in the moon's reflection, leaves messages in the past.

The group arranges an evacuation: Lauma takes the Southern Isles and Hiisi Island toward Natlan, and Arlecchino and the Fatui take everything north of the design bureau toward Snezhnaya. Albedo discovers that the energy fields are Light Realm energy and that Dottore has swapped human minds into animals.

185.comment: Version 6.3: A Traveler on a Winter's Night: True Moon
185.content:
Act VIII of Song of the Welkin Moon. The Wanderer rescues the Traveler. Columbina meets the Moon Sisters in their prison and, with their help, returns. In the final battle against Dottore she and the Traveler overcome his Heretic of the False Moon form, but Sandrone dies saving the Traveler. Afterwards Columbina lives with the Frostmoon Scions, shows the Traveler their spaceship on the Frost Moon, and gives the Traveler a gift that loosens some of Teyvat's limits on the elements.

In the spaceship, flight logs show it passed Teyvat once thousands of years earlier. Columbina says that it was placed on the Frost Moon by the Heavenly Principles. Varka writes to Jean that the expedition will return to Mondstadt in waves.
