186.comment: Version 6.4: Homeward, He Who Caught the Wind
186.content:
Version 6.4: Homeward, He Who Caught the Wind (also: Version 6.4, Patch 6.4, Version Luna V, Luna V, Song of the Welkin Moon: Variation, Homeward, He Who Caught the Wind update): Version Luna V (numbered 6.4 on the wiki, with the Archon Quest subtitle "Song of the Welkin Moon: Variation") was released on 2026-02-25, after Luna IV. It added Varka, Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius, his first Story Quest and a Mondstadt homecoming event. It opened no new area.

The Story Quest, Lupus Majoris Chapter Act I, follows Varka's last expedition in Nod-Krai against a corrupted fragment of the wolf god Andrius, while Mondstadt waits for the Knights to come home.

The event, "Homeward, He Who Caught the Wind", is a Mondstadt welcome ceremony for the returning Knights and plays out in four modes. The Serenitea Pot also received a Nod-Krai realm layout.

This entry is a patch-note summary, not character lore. The Story Quest ends with major revelations about Varka and the Bloodstained Knight and is described in a version-tagged sub-entry.

Release: Released 2026-02-25. Previous: Luna IV. Next: Luna VI.

New character: Varka ("Knight of Boreas", 5-star Anemo claymore). New weapon: Gest of the Mighty Wolf (5-star claymore). New weapon appearances: Unbreakable: Durandarte and Phantasmal Gift: Star Omen.

Phase one wishes: "The Northerly Wind's Song of Triumph" (Varka), "The Lone Light Knocks at Night" (Flins) and "Ode to the Dawn Breeze" (Mondstadt Chronicled Wish). Phase two: "Void Star's Advent" (Skirk) and "La Chanson Cerise" (Escoffier). Events included Sightseeing With Friends, Operation Stronghold Defense and Overflowing Abundance.

Additions included the Shadowflit Archipelago Serenitea Pot realm layout, Nod-Krai card back and box for the Genius Invokation TCG, the Harmonic Keys gadget, the Radiant Moongecko monster and the new World Quests "Nameless Bloodstained Monument" and "Stories to Sate the Glass and Scroll". Imaginarium Theater seasons began on 2026-03-01 and 2026-04-01.

New content: Varka. Lupus Majoris Chapter Act I, "To Those Who Embark on the Expedition". Event: Homeward, He Who Caught the Wind.

The Story Quest needs Adventure Rank 40 and "True Moon", the final Act of Song of the Welkin Moon, though players who have not reached it can use a quick start from "A New Star Approaches".

key: Homeward He Who Caught the Wind
187.comment: Version 6.4: Homeward, He Who Caught the Wind: Version 6.4 Homeward event
187.content:
This flagship event ran from 2026-02-27 to 2026-03-16. It needed Adventure Rank 20 and Prologue Act III, "Song of the Dragon and Freedom", and players are advised to finish "True Moon" and Lupus Majoris Chapter Act I first. The Traveler and Paimon are invited to Mondstadt for a welcome ceremony from the Knights of Favonius.

The event has four modes: Echoes of Memory (finding differences with the Spotter Kamera), A Chat Over Fine Drinks (running the Knights' drink stand), Lionfang's Radiant Onslaught (a stage-play battle) and Favonius Falcon's Recon Log (flying a falcon on scouting routes). Completing them earns Windscape Splendor, with the weapon appearance "Phantasmal Gift: Star Omen" as a reward. This is limited event content.

key: To Those Who Embark on the Expedition
188.comment: Version 6.4: Homeward, He Who Caught the Wind: Version 6.4 Lupus Majoris Chapter
188.content:
"To Those Who Embark on the Expedition" has three quests: Triumphant Warrior, Fated Warrior and Lonely Warrior. It begins with Venti, who learns that Varka's expedition has ended and that Lohen, Vice Captain of the 5th Company, is delivering Varka's letters to friends of the Knights.

The Traveler learns that Andrius's soul was split in two long ago: one part stayed in Nod-Krai, and the other, Boreas, settled in Mondstadt. The Abyss has replaced the vanished Rerir with a figure calling itself Roland, who corrupted Andrius's remains. Boreas gives the Traveler a blessed claymore to bring to Varka, and Varka sets out to recover scattered Wolf Spirit fragments with the Traveler, his knights and allies in Nod-Krai.

Roland swallows Varka after destroying his sword, and Varka enters a space inside the wolf, collecting the longings of Rostam, Ravenwood and the Wandering Knight. He reveals that his letters were meant to anchor him to the living, and that he had hidden Boreas's soul in himself, not in the sword. He frees Andrius to return to the ley lines, treats the Roland he meets as a false copy and leaves Rostam's letter at Roland's sword before waking at Windrise, where his friends are waiting. Earlier in the quest Jean tells the Traveler that if Varka failed to return she would become Grand Master and train his successor. These are story events, and the status of the real Roland is left open.

key: Song of the Welkin Moon: Rondo
189.content:
Version 6.5: Augured Homecoming (also: Version 6.5, Patch 6.5, Version Luna VI, Luna VI, Song of the Welkin Moon: Rondo, Augured Homecoming update): Version Luna VI (numbered 6.5 on the wiki, with the Archon Quest subtitle "Song of the Welkin Moon: Rondo") was released on 2026-04-08, after Luna V. It added Linnea, the area Windrest Peak in northern Mondstadt and the sky realm Temple of Space. It had no Archon Quest.

Linnea's first Story Quest, the Alcyon Chapter Act I, is set in Nod-Krai. The world quest series "A Long Day in the Mountains" introduces Windrest Peak and the Temple of Space, which is reached from its Old Sanatorium Site.

The version also ran the event "Where Waves Meet the Reef" with the character Jahoda as a reward. Windrest Peak's world quests begin at Dornman Port with "The Wind Has Ceased".

This entry is a patch-note summary, not character lore. Details of the Temple of Space and Linnea's family are major spoilers and sit in version-tagged sub-entries.

Release: Released 2026-04-08. Previous: Luna V. Next: Luna VII.

New character: Linnea ("Augur of Wonders", 5-star Geo bow). New weapon: Golden Frostbound Oath (5-star bow). New areas: Windrest Peak and Temple of Space.

Phase one wishes: "Ya-hoho! Compendium" (Linnea) and "Piercing Shot's Crimson Wake" (Chasca). Phase two, from 2026-04-28: "Moonsong of the Groves" (Lauma), "Temptation of the Crimson Sands" (Nefer) and "Dewlit Tranquility" (Fontaine Chronicled Wish).

New events: Where Waves Meet the Reef, Rapid Capture and Surveying & Mapping Studies. New monsters: The Open-Eyed, Domain Keeper, Churldric and "Prince Mahavasudeva-Yava". New materials included the Etherwing Moth and Windrest Flower, and wildlife such as the Windvigil Angler Gull and Camelhorn Deer. A new achievement was "Demon Mountain's Breath".

New content: Linnea. Alcyon Chapter Act I, "Up! Toward Homecoming Wings". World quests including the "A Long Day in the Mountains" series.

Other world quests: "Forest Boar Pauses for the Bloom", "Submerged Dragon, Soaring Phoenix" and "Winds Beneath the Tower of Silence". A new Temple of Space system, the Memory Core, accepts Memory Factors for rewards.

190.comment: Version 6.5: Augured Homecoming: Version 6.5 Windrest Peak
190.content:
Windrest Peak is the northernmost part of Mondstadt, centred on the port town of Dornman Port, with Millhaven and the Old Sanatorium Site nearby. It is new in this version.

The wiki notes that Windrest Peak has different clouds and clearer weather than the rest of Mondstadt as it was before this version. A loading tip says wind is forbidden from entering the Temple of Space, which leaves Windrest Peak perpetually windy.

According to the wiki, the Temple of Space was originally connected to a temple at Windrest Peak where survivors of Arcadia worshipped Istaroth. After the temple above was lifted away, the earthly one fell into ruin and later became the site of the local sanatorium.

191.comment: Version 6.5: Augured Homecoming: Version 6.5 Temple of Space
191.content:
The Temple of Space is an area in the sky above Windrest Peak, with its own map and exploration progress. It is unlocked through the world quest "The Wind Has Ceased" and entered from a marker at the Old Sanatorium Site. The wiki says it was created by Asmoday, called the Ruler of Space, as an exhibition hall that preserves the records of fallen civilisations.

The wiki lists Hyperborea, Lang-Gan, Delphi Pytho, Ochkanatlan, Remuria and Arcadia among those preserved. It has three exhibition areas: Luyang Academy, the Mahavaipulya Chamber and the Desert Pavilion. Inside, time stands still, and residents do not age, tire or die. A juvenile Watcher named Dex lets the player manipulate objects in the temple.

Asmoday also made the Watchers Nihilita and Melanta, who bring chosen people called the Uplifted into the temple and enforce her decree that it exist only for preservation, with all innovation forbidden. The Uplifted pass through the Apathic Interval and cannot leave unless they build a Path to the Heavens in the Corridor of Nothingness, which requires offering up all their memories. The uplifting is said to have ended. These are the wiki's summaries of quest text.

192.comment: Version 6.5: Augured Homecoming: Version 6.5 Alcyon Chapter
192.content:
"Up! Toward Homecoming Wings" is the first Act of Linnea's Story Quest, the Alcyon Chapter. It needs Adventure Rank 40 and "An Elegy for Faded Moonlight" from Song of the Welkin Moon, and the chapter is fully finished only after "A Nocturne of the Far North". Its quests are The Championship Begins, Twice Upon a Gaze and Tread the Right Path.

In Nasha Town Katheryne tells the Traveler about the Spirit Envoy Championship, which the Frostmoon Scions hold to strengthen bonds between people and animals, and which only allows common species. Linnea, an Adventurers' Guild advisor who lectures at Speranza, enters with the Jack Frost fae Lumi, while the Traveler enters with Aguara, and Mualani and Arataki Itto also compete.

Linnea is a changeling with wings on her head. She learns that Celaeno, a rival competitor with the Radiant Bladehorn Haemus, is her sister and that they belong to the rare Augury Birds, fae who can foresee their own futures. Their parents had Linnea live among humans so her ability would develop later. In the semifinal Lumi grows in size and Linnea realises Geo is what makes her special among Jack Frosts. The Traveler wins the final, and Celaeno promises to tell their parents how Linnea is doing. Linnea decides that a foreseen future need not be accepted as it is.

193.comment: Version 6.6: Truth Amongst the Pages of Purana
193.content:
Version 6.6: Truth Amongst the Pages of Purana (also: Version 6.6, Version Luna VII, Luna VII, Song of the Welkin Moon: Andante, Truth Amongst the Pages of Purana version): Version Luna VII (numbered 6.6 on the wiki), "Truth Amongst the Pages of Purana", was released on 2026-05-20 and is subtitled "Song of the Welkin Moon: Andante". It added Acts IX and X of the Song of the Welkin Moon Archon Quest, which bring an Irminsul crisis to Sumeru and end it, and the playable characters Nicole and Prune, followed by Lohen in the second half. It opened no new area.

It follows Version 6.5 and precedes Version Luna VIII (6.7). The Archon Quest begins with the Traveler in Nod-Krai and then returns to Sumeru. The tagline describes an absurd dream in which a not-yet-decided future comes briefly into view.

The version announced the first season of Imaginarium Theater for 2026-06-01, and introduced the Witch's Homework World Quest series and a score album titled Hexerei: Ballad of Whimsical Polyphony.

Much of this version's story is spoiler-heavy; it is recorded in a marked sub-entry so that readers who want only release facts can skip it.

Release: Released 2026-05-20, between Version Luna VI and Version Luna VIII.

Phase I (2026-05-20) had Angel's Reverie (Nicole and Prune) and Rubedo, of White Stone Born (Durin and Prune). Phase II (2026-06-09) had Frostedge Nocturne (Lohen) and Ancient Flame Ablaze (Mavuika).

New weapons were the 5-star catalyst Angelos' Heptades and the 5-star polearm Disaster and Remorse, plus a new weapon appearance, Super Awesome Magic Key. The new artifact sets were Celestial Gift and Disenchantment in Deep Shadow.

Characters: Nicole ("Clamor Within", a 5-star Pyro catalyst user of the Hexenzirkel), Prune ("Childlike Dreams Cherished", a 4-star Anemo catalyst user) and Lohen ("Sharpened Arrowhead", a 5-star Cryo polearm user and Knights of Favonius vice captain) were added.

Nicole and Prune debuted on 2026-05-20, and Lohen on 2026-06-09. The wiki gives all three the Hexerei team bonus. Lohen's Story Quest is the Lepus Miles Chapter, Act I, "A Knight's Legacy".

Quests: Archon Quest: Song of the Welkin Moon Act IX, "As All Falls to Emptiness", and Act X, "Truth Amongst the Pages of Purana". World Quests were the Beyond Silver and Fine Gold chain (Nicole), the Witch's Homework series with "A Proposition Beyond Refutation", "Proof of Strength" and "The Role of a Guide...?", and "A Window Into the World".

The version added a Guiding Notes function for active quests and a quest-saving notification, the Repertoire of Myriad Melodies album Hexerei: Ballad of Whimsical Polyphony with score themes Eclipsing Flame and Demon-Slaying Gale, and the weekly reward feature To Temper Thyself and Journey Far.

key: Truth Amongst the Pages of Purana
Of Myriad Paths Flux and Dissolution
194.comment: Version 6.6: Truth Amongst the Pages of Purana: Song of the Welkin Moon Acts IX and X
194.content:
Act IX: an anomaly stops Irminsul from recording and processing information, Nahida takes over its work and collapses, and Sumeru's people evacuate to Caravan Ribat. Dottore's Fatui, the Jinn and a barrier around Sumeru complicate matters, while Nicole and Nefer arrive from Nod-Krai and the Traveler wakes Liloupar. Act X: the group overloads Irminsul through the Akasha System and Aaru, the Traveler brings Nahida the Pyro Gnosis from Natlan, and Nahida burns the corrupted tree. Dottore dies in the process.

Per the wiki summary, Nahida explains that the attacker entered Irminsul through death, and a second Irminsul tree emerges in Sumeru City. Wanderer fights Dottore, who reveals that he knows the Wanderer's erased identity as Scaramouche. Nahida asks permission of the three Shades before burning Irminsul, which took seven days and nights, and Aaru took over the tree's role of collecting information. The Pyro Gnosis disappears without a trace. A letter from Pulcinella to Nahida says he had killed the Harbinger Sandrone and apologises for Dottore's trouble. Liloupar removes Collei's god remains at her request and fades away.

195.comment: Version 6.6: Truth Amongst the Pages of Purana: Version 6.6 events and gameplay
195.content: Limited events were Phantasmal Pals, Trials of the Brave Warrior and Kaleidoscopic Color Chase. Imaginarium Theater's first season from June 1 required Pyro, Cryo and Geo characters, and a new Spiral Abyss season from June 16 gave a 60 percent Cryo and Pyro damage bonus on Floor 11 and added the Blessing of the Abyssal Moon, Frost-Surging Moon. The domains Thorny Crown of the Mountain Wind and Binding Field of Universal Nirvana were added.

key: Song of the Welkin Moon: Scherzo
196.content:
Version 6.7: Sunny Summer Fontinalia (also: Version 6.7, Version Luna VIII, Luna VIII, Song of the Welkin Moon: Scherzo): Version Luna VIII (numbered 6.7 on the wiki), "Sunny Summer Fontinalia", was released on 2026-07-01 with the subtitle "Song of the Welkin Moon: Scherzo". It opened two new Nod-Krai areas, Dunanna Pit and the Frost Moon, added Sandrone as a playable five-star Cryo Claymore user, and brought a summer film-festival event in Fontaine. It had no Archon Quest.

It follows Version Luna VII and precedes Version 7.0. The headline story content was the Fontaine Story Quest Sunny Summer Fontinalia, the Frost Moon world-quest series Moon Gazing, and a long series of tea-party quests tied to Sandrone.

New systems were the Cryo-and-Electro reaction Stellar-Conduct, the Witch's Revelation talent system, the Repertoire of Myriad Melodies music feature and the Ancient Moon's Remnant waypoints on the Frost Moon.

The wiki notes that the Frost Moon lies geographically outside Teyvat's surface, though the game counts it as a Nod-Krai subregion for gameplay purposes.

Release: Released 2026-07-01, between Version Luna VII and 7.0.

Phase I banners were Heavenlit Prophecy (a Witch's Revelation Lightrace Wish), To the Looking-Glass the Mademoiselle Said (Sandrone) and Starry Night's Whispers (Citlali). Phase II, from 2026-07-21, was Somnias a Luna (Columbina) and a Raiden Shogun rerun.

The new weapon was A Teaspoon of Transcendence, a five-star Claymore. Outfits were Whispers of Stars and Smoke (Citlali) and Hurlock Variations (Charlotte). The Spiral Abyss refreshed on July 16 with a Cryo and Electro focus, and a new Imaginarium Theater season opened on August 1.

The version also introduced a quest-dialogue change, first on Sunny Summer Fontinalia and Moon Gazing, letting players advance lines without waiting for them to finish. A Souvenir Shop run by the Voynich Guild opened for players who upgraded all Nod-Krai Meeting Points and both Ancient Moon's Remnants.

Areas: Dunanna Pit lies in Nod-Krai, close to Fontaine and east of Pohjola. The Frost Moon is reached by progressing the Moon Gazing quests and has three parts: the Lunar Highlands, the Moontide Sea and the Dark Side of the Moon. Outside Ungien's Circle its turbulent Archaeolune energy alters gravity, giving higher jumps and slower falls.

Per the wiki, the Frost Moon is the second of the Three Moons made by Nibelung and the only one to survive the war of funerary flame intact, though it was banished beyond the false sky. Dragons led by Ibni-Belum later settled it for Project Moongazer. The Moontide Sea came from Lusalim's failed Lunar Veil project, and Ungien's Circle is a vivarium built by the dragon Ungien.

Secret Source technology is present on the moon, and new enemies include the Precursor's Secret Source Matrix of Overseer Network and Prism Slimes. New wildlife are the Moonglow Frostfin Whale and Moonglow Jellyfish. The wiki says the Frost Moon was revitalised and drawn back inside the false sky in Act VIII (True Moon) of Song of the Welkin Moon.

Quests: The Story Quest Sunny Summer Fontinalia has three acts: Should We Meet Again, Those We Have Lost and Those We Have Kept. World quests include the Moon Gazing series (Pioneers, Visitors From the Stars, Project Moongazer), Beneath the Lunar Sea, The Unmanned Vessel, Origin of the Sequence and Within the Sequence.

Seven Witch's Revelation quests unlock extra talents for Wriothesley, Yae Miko, Cyno, Yumemizuki Mizuki, Qiqi, Diona and Beidou, after Revelations by Chance grants the Witch's Revelation Case. The quests need a character at level 70 or higher. A series of Sandrone's Portable Tea Table quests includes re-invitations for a range of guests.

Events: The flagship event Sunny Summer Fontinalia ran from 2026-07-01 to 2026-08-11 around the Fontinalia Film Festival, with Charlotte as the character reward. Players run an aquarium through Operation Deep-Dive Treasure, Kaleido-Catch and Curio Ledger. Other events were Final Long-Range Sightlines, Dance Dance Easy-Breezy Disco and Ley Line Overflow.

When We Look Up at the Moon was an exploration mission running until 2026-09-22, giving 400 Primogems for completing Moon Gazing and for exploration milestones across the four new areas. The Story Quest stays playable after the event ends.

197.comment: Version 6.7: Sunny Summer Fontinalia: Version Luna VIII
197.content:
Luna VIII is the official name of what the wiki numbers 6.7. It released on 2026-07-01 and opened the Frost Moon and Dunanna Pit while adding Sandrone.

Its next update on the wiki's list is Version 7.0.

198.content: Stellar-Conduct is a Stellar Glimmer reaction between Cryo and Electro. It leaves a Starlight Prism lasting 7 seconds that sustains a Polestar Field, in which Cryo and Electro hits are recorded and buffs granted. This is a gameplay mechanic, not an in-world description.

199.content:
Version 7.0: Everwinter Without Mercy (also: Version 7.0, Genshin Impact 7.0): Version 7.0, "Everwinter Without Mercy", was released on 2026-08-12. It opened Snezhnaya, the Cryo nation, as a new playable region and began Archon Quest Chapter VII with Act I (Everwinter Without Mercy) and Act II (Wraith's Nocturne). It added Odette, a five-star Cryo Sword user, and Alyosha, a four-star Electro Polearm user, and the Traveler gained a Cryo form.

It follows the version the wiki numbers 6.7 (Luna VIII) and precedes 7.1. The story takes the Traveler and Paimon to the frozen north, the nation where the Tsaritsa has been gathering the Gnoses, where an energy shortage, a theater trapped in a snowstorm and the Ruler of Death all collide.

Chapter VII is the first Archon Quest set in Snezhnaya. The wiki notes that it was first designated "Act VI" in the Teyvat chapter storyline preview and was numbered Chapter VII after the Song of the Welkin Moon was added, though the Song of the Welkin Moon was never officially called Chapter VI. The release date was first revealed by an old promotional code, Snezhnaya20260812, according to the wiki trivia.

The wiki's version blurb reads that death visits every cold, unguarded night, leaving souls weeping for everything they held dear. The two acts released here end with the Tsaritsa returning from slaying the monster behind the blizzards; the story continues in 7.1, which is the canon cutoff of this archive.

Release: Released 2026-08-12. New region: Snezhnaya, with Volkodlak Tundra, Everfrozen Earth, Fellfrost Peak, Flamefeather Valley and White Birch Snowgrave.

Phase I banners were Swan's Shadow in Silken Ice (Odette and Alyosha) and The Hearth's Ashen Shadow (Arlecchino and Alyosha). Phase II banners were The Lone Light Knocks at Night (Flins) and Astral Actuation (Ineffa). The new five-star weapon was Whitelake Frostfeather (Sword). New artifact sets were Scarlet Proof and Heart of the Furnace. The new Traveler weapon was the Exaiphanes Blade, and the new outfit was Hunt in the Snow.

New systems included the Stellar Swirl elemental reaction, the Meeting Point locations (Korolevskiy Theater for Odette, Huntsman's Cabin for Alyosha and Tidesong Cavern for Vodyanitsa), the third-person-shooter Shadow Realm with the Special Recruitment Project Cycle Training, the Eye of Graeae gadget and the Snezhnaya Adventure Journal. New events were Great Expeditionist Challenge, Mutual Aid in Bloom: Into the Frostlands, Trial of the Bastion and Overflowing Abundance.

New enemies included Volkodlak, chimeric monsters, Wildwood Leshies, Immortal Constructs and other fae. New materials included Rimecurrant, Glaciafruit, Frostfairy Flower and Lumifluorite. New Snezhnayan dishes included Borscht, Medovik, Stroganina and Glupov Rye Bread. Genius Invokation TCG gained Jahoda, Durin and Hydro Hypostasis character cards and a Snezhnaya card back. Imaginarium Theater opened on 2026-09-01 requiring Hydro, Electro and Dendro, and the Spiral Abyss was refreshed on 2026-08-16 with Stellar Swirl and Stellar-Conduct themed Ley Line Disorders.

Characters: Odette ("Swirling Snow") is a five-star Cryo Sword character; in the story she is a Fatui ballerina who is also the outlaw known as Lelek. Alyosha ("Swift-Striding Hound") is a four-star Electro Polearm character, a hunter from Sretomorozsk who keeps a hunting dog named Tugarin. Vodyanitsa appears as a singer of the Korolevskiy Troupe in 7.0 and becomes playable in 7.1. Their own files carry their profiles.

The Traveler also gains a Cryo form in this version. Returning characters with banners were Arlecchino, Flins and Ineffa.

Archon quest: Chapter VII Act I, Everwinter Without Mercy, requires the Prologue and has four quests: Into the Wind, Into the Frigid North; Gunfire in the Silent Lands; Great Deeds on the Tundra; and Silence Alone is Disfavored. Act II, Wraith's Nocturne, has five parts: The White Curtain Falls, Lelek's Confession, Winter's Mysterious Silence, Wraith's Nocturne and Mistilteinn.

In Act I, Paimon falls ill soon after crossing into Snezhnaya, and the Traveler is helped by the ancient Eye of Graeae, which recognises them as a Descender. The Traveler meets Pierro by chance, then Alyosha, who explains Project Stuzha, the state plan to cut energy use, and the Kresnik Kristall shortages it causes. They expose corruption in Sretomorozsk, are pulled briefly into the Shadow Realm, reach Snezhnograd, meet Sandrone, Tartaglia and Odette, and are invited by Alyosha to join the secret group Rokot.

Act II traps the Traveler, Alyosha, Odette, Vodyanitsa and other theatergoers in the Korolevskiy Theater during a blizzard, where two people die each night. The deaths are caused by the Curse of Death of Ronova, the Ruler of Death, who treats the theater as an afterlife. Along the way ghosts such as Shram and Ptashka are identified, and Odette is revealed to be Lelek. Afterward Pierro takes Paimon to the Armory Palace; he explains that Project Mistilteinn, an anti-Celestia weapon, was making her ill because she is a being of Celestia, and that he once presented Paimon as a gift to the Khaenri'ahn king Irmin. Pierro and Mitya agree to pause the project until Ronova is dealt with. The act ends with the Tsaritsa returning from her fight and being greeted at Zapolyarny Palace, accompanied by the Druzhna, its commander Vesna and the head maid Danica.

200.content:
Version 7.0 (2026-08-12) is the release that opened Snezhnaya and started Archon Quest Chapter VII. New characters were Odette and Alyosha, the Traveler gained a Cryo form, and the Stellar Swirl reaction and the Shadow Realm shooter mode were introduced.

The following version, 7.1, continues Chapter VII with Acts III and IV.

201.comment: Version 7.0: Everwinter Without Mercy: Chapter VII
201.content:
Chapter VII is the Archon Quest set in Snezhnaya. Acts I and II came in 7.0 and Acts III and IV in 7.1, which is the canon cutoff for this archive. Its acts are Everwinter Without Mercy, Wraith's Nocturne, White Night, Like a Dream Upon Waking, and A Rekviem for the Underworld.

Act I requires only the Prologue. The chapter number follows the Song of the Welkin Moon, which was never officially called Chapter VI.

202.comment: Version 7.0: Everwinter Without Mercy: Wraith's Nocturne
202.content:
Wraith's Nocturne is Chapter VII Act II. A blizzard keeps theatergoers in the Korolevskiy Theater, and each night two of them die in a recurring dream. The cause turns out to be Ronova's Curse of Death, which strikes whenever Fatui research threatens a breakthrough against Celestia.

Those who die are revived with no memory of the event. Odette finds that her Cor Ignis can help a person wake from the afterlife faster. The Traveler chooses to side with Pierro and the Tsaritsa's faction because Ronova wants to take Paimon.

key: Version 7.1: A Rekviem for the Underworld
203.comment: Version 7.1: A Rekviem for the Underworld
203.content:
Version 7.1: A Rekviem for the Underworld (also: Version 7.1, Genshin Impact 7.1): Version 7.1, "A Rekviem for the Underworld", was released on 2026-09-23 and is the canon cutoff of this archive. The wiki lists no new area. Its main content was Archon Quest Chapter VII Act III (White Night, Like a Dream Upon Waking) and Act IV (A Rekviem for the Underworld), and two new five-star characters: Vesna, an Anemo Sword user, and Vodyanitsa, a Hydro Catalyst user.

It follows Version 7.0. Act III has the Traveler meet the Tsaritsa at court and learn why she seeks the Gnoses, while the Fatui look for a way to counter the Curse of Death. Act IV ends with the Ruler of Death Ronova losing her Authority and being mortally wounded, and with a Nail above the Cryo Dragon's corpse beginning to crumble.

Alongside the Archon Quest the version added a Travelers' Tales series, Snowstride Chapter, with short stories for Alyosha, Odette, Vesna, Vodyanitsa, Tartaglia, Sandrone, Jahoda, Charlotte, Clorinde and Lyney. The Genshin Impact 6th Anniversary profile background appears in the version gallery.

A known issue noted at launch was an English voice-over line in the cutscene of the quest One Move Left to Make that did not match the text, including an incorrect pronoun. On 2026-09-24 a patch fixed a problem that blocked progress in the Black Feathers Scattered at Parting domain and corrected an English description of Vodyanitsa's Elemental Skill.

Release: Released 2026-09-23, after 7.0. No new area.

Phase I banners were When Warm Winds Cavort (Vesna) and Surging Ballad (Vodyanitsa). Phase II banners were Void Star's Advent (Skirk) and La Chanson Cerise (Escoffier). New five-star weapons were Beyond the Chrysalis (Sword) and Hymn of the Maelstrom (Catalyst). New four-star weapons were New Bough (Sword), Breezeborne Refrain (Bow), Winter's Heavy Heart (Catalyst) and Silver Light (Sword).

New events were Silverwing in Pursuit of the Moon, Carefree Snowball Fight, Predictive Victory Dynamics, Overflowing Favor, Rainbow's End: Resplendent Starlight, Across the Frozen Wilds, Honing One's Edge, and Tabletop Troupe: A Gathering on Adventure's Eve. Edge of Survival gained two stages, Fiery Feather Pursuit and Ice-Imprisoned Citadel, and the Special Recruitment Project: Consultant to the Tsaritsa was added. The new enemy was the Guardian Blade of Drifting Snow.

Imaginarium Theater was scheduled to open on 2026-10-01 requiring Hydro, Cryo and Anemo, with a second season on 2026-11-01 requiring Hydro, Electro and Geo. A new Spiral Abyss season was scheduled for 2026-10-16 with Anemo and Cryo themed Ley Line Disorders and the Stardread Moon blessing. Genius Invokation TCG gained Columbina and Illuga cards and the Lunar-Crystallize reaction card Moondrift Harmony. New dishes were Celestial Tea Crisp, Mors and Royal Grilled Fish.

Characters: Vesna ("Snowy Banquet's Sharp Blade") is a five-star Anemo Sword character; in the story she commands the Druzhna and carries the mark of life. Vodyanitsa ("Lingering Siren-Song") is a five-star Hydro Catalyst character; she is the lead singer of the Korolevskiy Troupe and, like Alyosha, a member of the secret group Rokot. Their own files carry their profiles.

New namecards were Vesna: Revelry, Vodyanitsa: Whirlpool, Travel Notes: Moontrace and Snezhnaya: Frostfall. Character specialty dishes were Iridescent Aria and Hoarfrost Soup.

Archon quest act iii: White Night, Like a Dream Upon Waking (Chapter VII Act III) has three quests: Light and Shadow, Intertwined; Sparks Converging Upon the Tundra; and One Move Left to Make. The Traveler is approved for an audience with the Tsaritsa, who sets aside investigations into them and grants unrestricted access to the palace.

The Tsaritsa, Anastasya, explains that she wants the Gnoses to gain enough power to face the Heavenly Principles, since Snezhnaya's growth has brought it to the limit of what they permit and left it under threat of a Celestial Nail. A crystalline seal left by the Third Descender lies in a hidden chamber and reacts only to the Gnoses. She says her Authority is love but refuses to use that identity. She records each day in a transcription prism because she distrusts memory. Project Mistilteinn is halted until Ronova can be dealt with.

At the Armory Palace, Pierro uses a prism called the Mirror of Remembrance to review memories and finds that Ronova had been working with Rhinedottir, who revived the people Ronova killed before the Shades could notice. Vesna, who carries a small Authority of life inherited through the first Vila, extracts "Seals of Life", bubbles holding an impactful memory, as a way to counter death. When the seals are collected from the public and officials, a theft is traced to Northland Bank, where the Traveler and Vesna face a creature made by the Ruler of Life with Pantalone's help.

Archon quest act iv: A Rekviem for the Underworld (Chapter VII Act IV) has three quests: Delusion, Etched in Time and Black Feathers Scattered at Parting. The Fatui prepare a new Delusion with Arlecchino's help, recover the notebook of Hroptatyr, and set a trap for Ronova.

Pierro explains that the authorities of Life, Death, Time and Space originally belonged to the Three Moons, and that the Crimson Moon held death. Arlecchino, as a Crimson Moon descendant, is therefore needed, and she says the House of the Hearth will become independent of the Fatui and stop training children as spies. The Harbingers vote unanimously to open Hroptatyr's notebook, which gives hints for the Delusion work, and the Traveler learns that Hroptatyr summoned their sibling at the same time Pierro summoned Paimon.

Dainsleif joins the plan. Rhinedottir visits the Tsaritsa's palace while Ronova's curse strikes at Rankova Zorya. The Tsaritsa uses the six Gnoses to manipulate the time and space around Rhinedottir, so that the window to revive Ronova's victims is missed, and Celestia seizes Ronova's Authority for abuse. Pierro's new Delusion then crushes Ronova. Project Mistilteinn is no longer restricted. Ronova, mortally wounded, reaches the Nail above the Cryo Dragon's corpse and fuses it with Eitr as a parting gift, so that the Nail begins to crumble and threatens to release Holy Soil over Teyvat.

204.comment: Version 7.1: A Rekviem for the Underworld: Version 7.1
204.content:
Version 7.1 (2026-09-23) is the latest version in this archive. It completed the first four acts of Chapter VII and added Vesna and Vodyanitsa. Nothing later is covered.

It follows 7.0 and ends with Ronova mortally wounded and a Nail of Retribution crumbling above the Cryo Dragon's corpse.

205.comment: Version 7.1: A Rekviem for the Underworld: A Rekviem for the Underworld
205.content:
A Rekviem for the Underworld is Chapter VII Act IV. It follows the Fatui plan to stop Ronova, with Pierro's new Delusion, Dainsleif's help and the Tsaritsa's manipulation of time during Rhinedottir's visit. Ronova loses her Authority and is crushed, but she reaches the Nail above the Cryo Dragon's corpse and damages it.

Dainsleif says the Snezhnayan victory over the Ruler of Death marks the start of a new, tumultuous era, and he meets Hroptatyr's remnants but is disappointed. The Tsaritsa personally commends all participants.

key: White Night Like a Dream Upon Waking
206.comment: Version 7.1: A Rekviem for the Underworld: White Night, Like a Dream Upon Waking
206.content:
White Night, Like a Dream Upon Waking is Chapter VII Act III. The Traveler meets the Tsaritsa, and Vesna's memory-bubble Seals of Life are gathered as a way to counter the Curse of Death.

Danica tests the Traveler with a Mora game in Podvorye Restaurant before apologising later, and the leaked news about the seals brings eager volunteers. Pantalone describes how he built Northland Bank by combining human and fae traditions.
